articleTitle: Research and Application of Smart Grid Early Warning Decision Platform Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, the key work of smart grid equipment fault prediction and early warning, dynamic operation and maintenance strategy research is studied by using large data mining analysis method. Spark, Hive, HDFS(Hadoop Distributed File System), MapReduce and other technologies are used to build a large data analysis and early warning decision-making platform for smart grid. In this paper, taking big data technology as the core, the BP neural network algorithm is optimized by using self-developed proprietary algorithm, which improves the accuracy of fault prediction model. The algorithm can realize the functions of intelligent inspection, intelligent research and judgment, intelligent early warning, intelligent decision-making and intelligent dispatch of substation equipment. Through a lot of practical verification, the accuracy of fault prediction of the platform is 93.98%, which is in the leading international level . In the field of smart grid, it has strong application value.

articleTitle: A Day-ahead Scheduling Optimization Model of Multi-Microgrid Considering Interactive Power Control
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient stability and security considerations for multi-microgrid system access distribution network, this paper proposes a multi-microgrid day-ahead scheduling optimization model considering interactive power control. The upper optimization model aims to reduce the interaction power between the microgrid and the distribution network and coordinates the output between the microgrids. The lower optimization model is devoted to solve the economic optimization operation of the multi-microgrid system. The bilateral bidding strategy is adopted to make the microgrid conduct energy trading to reduce the overall cost of the multi-microgrid system and reduce the impact of power fluctuations on the distribution network. The distribution network system with multiple microgrids is used to verify that the optimization model can obtain better output plans for each microgrid. The set trading strategy encourages effectively the mutual energy between the microgrids and reduces the micro-grid's impact of grid operation on the distribution network.

articleTitle: Analysis of Brazilian blackout on March 21st,2018 and revelations to security for Hunan Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Brazil ±800kV Xingu convertor station’s technical defects lead to chain reaction in Brazil that a Brazilian nationwide blackout accident happened on March 21st, 2018. This blackout severely impact the north and northeast of Brazil including 14 states. In this paper, the general situation of Brazilian power grid is introduced. And the occurrence and propagation of the blackout are retrospected. Furthermore, the main reason of the blackouts are analyzed in this article. According to the Brazilian blackout, Qishao DC is evaluated from the relay protection, configuration of security and stability equipment and strategy analysis of power plants’ primary frequency regulation. Combined with the reality of Hunan power grid, this paper sum up experience and lessons of Brazilian blackout.

articleTitle: Analysis of Reluctance Torque in Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines With Fractional Slot Concentrated Windings
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper presents analysis of saliency and reluctance torque in fractional slot concentrated winding interior permanent magnet synchronous machines. First, the background of torque production in IPM machines is illustrated. The inductance characteristics of fractional slot concentrated winding IPM machines are analyzed by winding function theory. The influence of rotor topology, key parameter and rotor flux barrier on reluctance torque are investigates by finite element analysis. Finally, a design example is provided to analyze the reluctance torque contribution in fractional slot concentrated winding IPM machines.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of an Intelligent Medicine Box
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: At present, there are a large number of elderly people in China, among whom a large proportion suffer from chronic diseases and need long-term medication. The elderly have poor memory but take a wide variety of drugs, so they often forget to take the medicine or take the medicine by mistake. In this paper, an intelligent medicine box control system is used to remind the elderly to take medicine on time. The intelligent medicine box controller adopts STM32 series single-chip microcomputer to control the sensor to sense the approach of human body, the motor to control the rotation of medicine box, and the LCD display screen and buzzer to help users complete the operation of taking medicine. And design an Application that makes use of friendly human-computer interaction interface to facilitate users to configure the data of the medicine box.

articleTitle: Design of Direct Drive Modular Permanent Magnet Generator With Magnetic Slot Wedges and Step-Skewed Outer Rotor for Wind Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The direct-drive low speed permanent magnet generator has received more attention in variable-speed wind power generation system due to high efficiency and simple structure, compared to conventional gearbox-coupled generator. This paper presents the design and analysis of direct drive modular permanent magnet generator with magnetic slot wedges and step-skewed outer rotor for wind power applications. First, the topology and features are introduced. Some significant design considerations of proposed large permanent magnet generator were illustrated. Finally, the finite element analysis was employed to predict and compare the electromagnetic performance.

articleTitle: The Key Technology of the Coordinated Control System of Wind Power and Energy-intensive Load
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the rapid increase of wind power installed capacity in power systems, wind power consumption has become one of the urgent problem of new energy sources. And the energy-intensive load has different levels of ability to participate in power grid regulation due to the characteristic of adjustment. This paper introduces a coordinated control system of wind power and energy-intensive load that mainly includes two parts: the main station and the sub-station. And the system can achieve coordinated control of a grid with high proportion of wind power and energy-intensive load. The main station of coordinated control system is set in the dispatch center, mainly realizing monitoring, substation control, data support, and effect evaluation. The sub-station of coordinated control system is set in the control center of energy-intensive enterprise, mainly realizing information exchange, energy-intensive load control and other functions. By constructing the system mentioned in this paper, energy-intensive load can participate in the coordinated control of a grid with high proportion of wind power, thus promoting wind power consumption.

articleTitle: Fractional Slot Concentrated Windings Interior Permanent Magnet Traction Motor With Modular Stator
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Fractional slot concentrated windings interior permanent magnet synchronous motor was an attractive candidate due to its compact structure, high efficiency, high power density. This paper presents analysis of a fractional slot concentrated windings interior permanent magnet synchronous motor with modular stator for electric vehicles traction. First, the features of conventional integral slot distributed windings and fractional slot concentrated windings was illustrated and compared. Some importantly design consideration of proposed FSCW IPM traction motor were discussed. Finally, a design example was presented. The electromagnetic performance and effect of additional gap due to modular stator core were predicted and evaluated by finite element analysis.

articleTitle: Bi-level Optimal Scheduling of Microgrid with Integrated Power Station Based on Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: A bi-level optimal scheduling model based on Stackelberg game is established for the economical operation of electric vehicle charging-swapping-storage integrated station(CSSIS) and microgrid with different ownership. As the leader , microgrid taking maximum profit as the objective function formulates the internal price of electricity trading with CSSIS. CSSIS acts as follower, adjusting its own charging/discharging plan according to the internal electricity price set by microgrid to achieve its maximum benefit. The differential evolution algorithm and Gurobi software are used to solve bi-level optimization problems respectively, as a results, the optimal internal electricity price and the optimal charge and discharge plan for CSSIS are obtained. The simulation case shows that the proposed algorithm can effectively solve the equilibrium strategy of interaction between microgrid and CSSIS, which can not only improve the their benefits , but also achieve mutual benefit and win-win, and more effectively use the resources of CSSIS.

articleTitle: Application of ETAP in distributed power supply and micro-grid interconnection
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the development of the global economy, the demand for energy is getting higher and higher and the advantages of the distributed power generation technology and micro-grid are more and more prominent. The author refers to the model of wind, light and micro-grid in a certain island in China, and uses ETAP to design the micro-grid model. Combined with the models in ETAP (wind turbine model, photovoltaic and photovoltaic inverter model, energy storage model, gas generator generation model, user-side load, industrial system load, cable transmission line model, transformer model, etc.), simulation analyses of micro-grid system under different operating conditions are carried out, including transient analysis of the micro-grid in grid-connected operation and transient analysis of the micro-grid system under external power network fault and recovery operation in grid-connected state. The simulation results have practical significance for real engineering.

articleTitle: Application of LoRa and NB-IoT in Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things: A Case Study of Fault Indicator in Electricity Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Traditional communication technologies based on 2G and 4G cannot meet the requirements of low-power wide-area data transmission in electricity distribution network. Ubiquitous power Internet of things (UPIoT) has thus been proposed by the State Grid of China and it can be used to transmit energy information requested from any location. Narrowband Internet of things (NB-IoT) and LoRa are two promising low-power wide-area communication technologies, which are capable of providing good performance to transmit data collected from the devices installed in the distribution network. In this paper, taking the fault indicator as an example, we combine LoRa and NB-IoT to construct a wireless network to transmit the operation status of fault indicator, which can improve the transmission distance and reduce the operating cost of the system. It adopts a communication mode including a master node and a plurality of child nodes to meet the needs of large-scale information monitoring. Among them, the design of the master node uses NB-IoT and LoRa communication technologies. The design of the child node uses LoRa communication technology and sensor technology. The control chip STM32F103C8T6 is used for data transmission, and the data is finally managed by a centralized means through upper computer software.

articleTitle: Analysis of Magnetic Field of Magnetic Gear during Overload
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to avoid defects of conventional mechanical gears, magnetic gears (MG) have been proposed as a device to improve torque density of electromechanical systems. However, the high reliability of MG is also very important. This study looks into the magnetic field of MG during overload, and investigates the cause of demagnetization of permanent magnets on rotor. Additional, the high stability MG is designed, indicating that some slots are slotted and supplied magnetic windings on the rotor. Finally, a MG model is established, and the air gap magnetic field and torque are simulated. The results verify the correctness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Operation Mode Optimization of Medium Voltage Distribution Networks based on Improved Binary Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Considering the operation economy and power quality of power distribution networks, a multi-objective optimization model of medium voltage intelligent distribution networks with objective functions of minimum network loss and switching frequency and maximum voltage deviation has established. The model has solved by an improved binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) algorithm introducing nonlinear dynamic adjustment of learning factor and inertial weight coefficient. The results of numerical calculation show that the proposed model can balance the network loss, voltage quality and frequency of switch actions compared with the traditional single-objective optimization model, and the proposed algorithm can not only balance global search ability and local search ability of the PSO algorithm, but also make the algorithm own faster convergence. Feasibility and validity of the proposed model and algorithm have been verified from the application.

articleTitle: LoRa-based Communication Technology for Overhead Line Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Internet of Things technology improves the state awareness level of power grid equipment through large-scale sensor collaboration and information communication network. In this paper, the application of LoRa low power wide area interconnection of things communication technology in overhead line state perception is studied. LoRa-based three-tier network architecture of low-power wide-area interconnection of things for overhead lines is proposed.This paper analyzed the communication and encryption between sensors and communication modules, communication modules and base stations, base stations and base stations. A design scheme of miniaturized state-aware device for overhead line based on LoRa is proposed. Two scenarios of application of LoRa-based state-aware technology for overhead line are listed, which can provide guidance for the popularization and application of the technology of Internet of Things for power equipment.

articleTitle: A Regional Smart Power Grid Distribution Transformer Planning Method Considering Life Cycle Cost
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: at present, in the research on transformation and adjustment of distribution transformers for regional smart power grid, most of them are around overhaul of high energy consumption or old transformers to prolong life. In the case of only one alternative distribution transformer, the original transformer is directly replaced by a lower power loss transformer to reduce cost. And through the comparison of these two aspects, the transformation plan can be determined. When there are a variety of alternative transformers, a replacement strategy of distribution transformers in regional smart power grid based on life cycle cost (LCC) is proposed in this paper. First, based on the life cycle cost of equipment level, the selection model of planning scheme is built. Then the replacement strategy is evaluated in order to clarify the most reasonable transformation mode and the best replaced time. Further, the feasibility and effectiveness of the strategy are verified by the relevant calculation examples. Finally, some measures to reduce LCC are put forward.

articleTitle: A Review of Battery State of Health Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Batteries as energy storage instruments are widely used in electric vehicles, uninterrupted power supply (UPS), communications and random fluctuations. The state of health (SOH) for batteries has a significant impact on traffic safety, communication reliability and energy efficiency. The performance of batteries is affected by the aging of batteries with the increase of service time. Due to the interaction of various factors, and the battery is a highly coupled, complex mechanism, non-linear parameter change system, the characterization of battery aging phenomenon is very complex. In this paper, the existing SOH estimation methods for batteries are reviewed and classified in different fields.

articleTitle: Intra-day Tie-line Scheduling Model Considering New Energy Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Fluctuations of new energy output cannot be effectively accommodated in the traditional cross-regional or cross-provincial tie-line scheduling since it’s established mainly based on power transactions, therefore, it is less involved in the intra-day adjustments. The Intra-day Tie-line Scheduling Model Considering New Energy Volatility is presented in this paper in response to this situation. In the Model, a intra-day scheduling model is established based on the cross-section of the tie-line and the sub-provincial reserve control after the treatment of their equivalent forms against fuzzy opportunity constraints of the spinning reserve according to credibility distribution function of the error in the new energy prediction. The result after applying the Model to the actual example indicates that the Model is useful to optimize the reasonable intra-day tie-line scheduling when the reserve is insufficient, and thus enhance the mutual-accommodation capacity of interconnected power grids to effectively improve the accommodation level of new energy.

articleTitle: Research and Applications of Key Technologies of Quantum Secure Communication in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the rapid development of energy Internet, interactions between the power communication network and the cyber Internet become increasingly frequent, resulting in information security threats. Power grid encryption algorithms are mainly based on computational complexity, which will be facilely cracked by the development of quantum computing. Meanwhile, the quantum security communication technology, which is absolutely safe in in theory, can cope with the challenges brought by the improvement of computing. Basing on quantum security communication technology, this paper proposes a general architecture of quantum security communication system in power grid. Problems existing in the application of quantum secure communication technology in power system and key technologies that required to be developed are analyzed concretely. Eventually, several typical energy Internet functions, such as major power-securing events and Unified meter reading and charging service (UMRCS) are proposed to verify the rationality and feasibility.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Drop Control Method for DC Microgrids with Accurate Current Sharing and DC Bus Voltage Restoration
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of traditional droop control in bus voltage stability and load current accurate sharing, an improved droop control strategy for autonomous DC microgrid with voltage self-recovery characteristic is proposed. The strategy obtains the line impedance information through the active identification method and introduces it into the droop coefficient in the form of negative compensation to suppress the adverse effect of line impedance inconsistency on current sharing. Besides, with the virtual bus voltage information, the translation compensation principle is utilized to realize the stable operation of bus voltage at the rated value. The proposed control method can not only simultaneously realize accurate load current sharing and the stability of bus voltage in the steady and dynamic process, but also can realize the decoupling control between them. Moreover, it has no need for interconnection communication, thus satisfying plug and play, greatly improving the reliability and scalability of the system. Finally, simulation results based on RT-lab platform verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Zero Ripple High-Gain DC/DC Converter Based on Switched Capacitor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: As an important supplement to fossil energy power generation, photovoltaic power generation has the advantages of clean and renewable energy. Due to the output voltage of photovoltaic power generation is too low to meet the demand of grid-connected inverters, a high-gain DC/DC converter for photovoltaic power generation is proposed in this paper. On the basis of the switched capacitor network, a ripple suppression circuit is introduced. The independent inductor is wound on the same core to form a coupled inductor, which reduces the volume of the magnetic component. The ripple absorption circuit is composed of auxiliary inductor and auxiliary capacitor, which overcomes the shortcoming of large input current ripple of high-gain converter based on switched capacitor. Moreover, the switch is not directly connected to the output, which reduces the voltage stress of the switch. On this basis, a quadratic boost circuit (QBC) is combined with the proposed circuit to further improve voltage gain. Finally, the simulation verification is carried out using the PSIM software on the basis of the principle analysis.

articleTitle: Impact of Inverter Interfaced Generators on Distance Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The large-scale inverter interfaced generators (IIG) integrated into power system shows more and more unique fault features. There are adaptability issues when traditional distance protections are used in such system. Aiming at the adaptability problem of distance protection configured on the tie line, a simulation model is built according to the local grid and the distance protection algorithm in protection device, and the influence of IIG on the distance protection of different principles in the actual protection device is comprehensively analyzed. The research results show that, due to the fault characteristics of IIG, the IIG side distance protection is prone to refuse to operate and misoperation, and the system side distance protection is prone to reverse misoperation. The research results of this paper provide reference for the engineering application and performance improvement of distance protection.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Adaptive Model Predictive Control for Interleaved Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, a direct current model predictive control (MPC) strategy is adopted to address the regulation of output voltage for the interleaved boost converter. The control strategy combines observer based adaptive laws with direct current predictive control to yield an adaptive and robust controller. The adaptive laws are designed for estimating unknown parameters using Lyapunov stability theory and updates the control law in real time. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy, simulation is implemented under the variation of input voltage, load resistance and output voltage reference.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement of Line Loss Algorithm Based on Three-phase Unbalance Degree
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Line loss calculation is an important part of power supply company management. However, when the traditional line loss calculation method is used in an area with a relatively unbalanced degree, the calculated theoretical value and actual value will have a large deviation. Therefore, the paper studies the three-phase unbalance and selects the appropriate unbalance algorithm. Through the dynamic acquisition of three-phase load current, the three-phase unbalance degree of the transformer region is calculated. Then according to the unbalance degree algorithm combined with the equivalent resistance method, the formula of the line loss increment under three-phase unbalance is derived. The paper combines this increment into the improved equivalent resistance method to obtain a line loss calculation method suitable for use in unbalanced stations. Finally, the paper calculates the unbalance degree and the line loss increment under the actual example. And calculating the line loss values respectively by the statistical line loss calculation method, the theoretical line loss calculation method based on the equivalent resistance method, and the theoretical line loss calculation method based on the equivalent resistance method. The comparison shows: The proposed algorithm is closer to the actual line loss than the traditional line loss algorithm. The algorithm in this paper is more accurate and effective, and it can reflect the actual operation. Therefore, in areas where the three-phase imbalance is more serious, the algorithm of this paper will have more advantages than traditional ones.

articleTitle: Unit Commitment Considering Electrolytic Aluminum Load for Ancillary Service
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Considering the huge potential of electrolytic aluminum load for demand response, this paper proposes a unit commitment model considering electrolytic aluminum for providing ancillary service. Firstly, based on the relevant characteristics of the pots which are the core equipment in aluminum smelting and without affecting the normal production of the aluminum plant, a model of the electrolytic aluminum load for providing ancillary service is established. Then, a unit commitment considering electrolytic aluminum load model for providing ancillary service is proposed. Results show that considering electrolytic aluminum load for providing ancillary service can reduce the total cost of the power system and improve the economy. Moreover, the net profit of the aluminum enterprise in providing ancillary service is analyzed.

articleTitle: High Power High Step-up DC/DC Converter Based on Multiple Input-Terminal Voltage Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Voltage multipliers (VMs) are widely used to combine with traditional DC/DC converter to achieve high voltage conversion gain. However, the input-terminals of existing VM circuits are unchangeable to two which make these converters are not suitable for high power/current applications. In this paper, a high power high step-up DC/DC converter based on multiple input-terminal voltage multiplier (MIVM) is presented. Analysis of the operation principles and the performance characteristics of the proposed converter are presented in detail. And an experimental prototype with a rated power of 800W was built to verify the correctness of the theory.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of High Frequency Transformer with Nanocrystalline Core
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: It is a smart choice to choose Nanocrystalline alloy for the high frequency transformer core, due to its attractive magnetic properties. Meanwhile, the Litz-wire can minimize the copper loss and had been widely used in designing of high frequency transformer. In this paper, the magnetic properties of Nanocrystalline alloy is tested, the core loss of high frequency transformer with Nanocrystalline core is calculated. Meanwhile, the copper loss of high frequency transformer with Litz-wire is calculated, in addition a method is proposed for design and optimization of high frequency transformer with nanocrystalline core and Litz-wire, the electromagnetic and thermal performances are evaluated by finite element method.

articleTitle: Mal-operation Phenomenon of Converter Transformer and Lead Wire Differential Protection during the Energization of "12-Pulse" Converter Transformer Group
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The mal-operations of the converter transformer and lead wire differential protection(DPTL) in HVDC converter station are recorded. In this paper, the initial conditions of a "12-Pulse" converter transformer group being energized are combined with the transformer flux expressions in the time domain. On this base, the generation mechanism and changing regularity of the symmetrical inrush during the energization are investigated by adopting the analytical method. Then, the reason that the second harmonic restraint criterion failing to block the DPTL is explained. A simulation model in accordance with an actual ±800kV UHVDC transmission project is established. The phenomenon is recurred and verified by virtue of simulation tests.

Author Keywords: converter transformer and lead wire differential protection(DPTL)

articleTitle: An Integrated Safety Management System Based on Ubiquitous Internet of Things in Electricity for Smart Pumped-storage Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The safety management is an important and fundamental task in the construction and operation of pumped-storage power stations. However, because of the traditional technical framework, the relevant systems are separated from each other, leading to a lot of disadvantages in application and performance. In order to meet the requirements of smart pumped-storage power stations, an integrated safety management system (ISMS) based on ubiquitous internet of things in electricity is proposed in this paper. The ISMS is divided into five layers including data display layer, data manipulation layer, data processing layer, data transmission layer and data acquisition layer. It consists of six modules, i.e., central control module, cave access control and personnel location module, video and security monitoring module, emergency broadcasting and communication module, geological warning module, and fall protection module. All modules are integrated into a unified information platform.

Author Keywords: ubiquitous internet of things in electricity

articleTitle: Survey of Frequency Response Analysis on Winding Deformation of Transformers
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: As a core equipment in power system, power transformer plays a vital role in the stability of the power grid. It is necessary to quickly and accurately monitor the fault of the transformer. Frequency response method is an important method for fault diagnosis of transformers. It has many advantages, such as simple and light test equipment, easy measurement and high test sensitivity, intuitive analysis of experimental maps, and comparability of data magnitude analysis. It is considered to be a detection method with good application prospects. In this paper, the monitoring principle of frequency response method and the influencing factors in practical application are analyzed, and the shortcomings of the method and the research direction of the next step are prospected.

articleTitle: An Inductor Current Balancing Technique for FLDLL Based Four-phase Buck Converter with Transient-modulated Constant On-time Control for Load Transient Response
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper presents a fast-locking delay-locked loop based (FLDLL) four-phase dc-dc converter with transient-modulated constant on-time control (TMCOT). Besides, the proposed converter can achieve inductor current balance through novel pulse-width-shrunk technique (PWST) automatically calibrating the duty cycle error and phase error of four-phase pulse-width modulation (PWM) signals in the DLL based multi-phase converters. In low-voltage and high-current load application, fast load transient response need to be further improved. Therefore, the proposed FLDLL includes an automatically switching single/dual triggered phase detector (ASS/DET-PD) to accomplish the fast-locking operation. The multi-phase buck converter operates at 10MHz, a load ranging from 0.4A to 1.4A, an input voltage of 3.3V, and an output voltage of 1.8V. These simulated results show that the output undershoot voltage and overshoot voltage both are below 10 mV, respectively. As well, these simulated recovery time in 1A step-up/down load both are 2.5μs, respectively. The fully-integrated circuit is implemented in TSMC 0.18-μm CMOS technology with 6.17 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> chip area, and it achieves 90.2% peak efficiency.

articleTitle: Valley-Period Dispatched Strategy of Electric Vehicles in Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have been gradually known to the public because of their advantages of energy saving and environmental protection. However, its charging behavior is random in space and time, which has an impact on the quality of the power grid and its safe and economic operation. A valley-period dispatched charging model and strategy based on the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed in this paper. It can make full use of each period of the valley-period to complete the charging of EVs, and reduce the peak-valley ratio of load profiles in the valley-period significantly. The Monte Carlo simulation is used to simulate the charging load profiles of EVs under different charging strategies. The results show that the proposed strategy can effectively optimize the charging load profiles of EVs in the valley-period.

articleTitle: A Contactless Healthcare System with Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Nowadays, healthcare is becoming a new issue increasingly that worthy to care. Healthcare measurement methods can be categorized into two main areas: contact and contactless. Among them, contactless has more flexibility and comfort. In this paper, we combined the pulse rate measurement and face recognition based on deep learning into an embedded system. The system can help people measure their pulse rate in real-time after recognize the face. Our system contains a graphics processing unit (GPU) and central processing unit (CPU) co-design platform in order to processing face recognition in real-time. The experimental results show the recognition average accuracy is 98%. In pulse rate detection aspect, the provided mean absolute error (MAE) and root-mean-square error (RMSE) are 5.095 BPM and 5.976 BPM. The results reveals that our system can truly apply in daily life. In the future, we hope our system can be utilized in several scenarios such as company door-access, driving monitor, industry, etc.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization design method of LCL filter based on harmonic stability of VSC system
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: As the high proportion of renewable energy based on power electronics technology is integrated into the grid, the problem of harmonic instability is becoming more and more prominent. This paper solves harmonic instability by optimizing the design of LCL filters. First, the impedance analysis method is used to obtain the positive network damping criterion as a constraint on the LCL filter. Combined with the external characteristics of the LCL filter. To build LCL parameter multi-objective optimization model with minimum inductance cost, maximum harmonic attenuation rate and best current tracking effect; Then, the MOEA/D optimization algorithm is used to solve the multi-objective optimization model; Finally, build the voltage source converter (VSC) system on the MATLAB/SIMULINK platform. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme has superiority and applicability.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Distributed Cooperative Droop Control of DC Microgrids: A Brief Survey
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Distributed cooperative secondary control (DCSC) based on droop control is an effective solution for the stable and efficient operation of the DC microgrids (MGs), and has received extensive attention in recent years. Aiming at the defects of traditional droop control, this paper focuses on the improved distributed cooperative droop control method in DC microgrid from two aspects: asymptotic consensus algorithm and finite-time consensus algorithm. Furthermore, the communication problems faced by distributed cooperative control and the corresponding solutions are analyzed. Finally, concluding remarks are drawn and some potential research directions are suggested.

articleTitle: A Novel Supraharmonics Measurement Method Based on Flexible Atom Filtering
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: More and more electrical equipment using power electronic devices are connected to the power system for the past few years. The continuous rise of supraharmonic emission level in distribution network has become one of the most severe power quality problems. Aiming at the problems of the existing supraharmonic algorithm, a method based on flexible atomic filter is proposed to measure the supraharmonic. By setting several flexible atomic filters (FAFs) in the supraharmonic band (2-150kHz), the filter measurement bandwidth covers the whole supraharmonic band without overlapping. The discrete supraharmonic signal and the discrete expression of FAFs are processed by inner product, and the corresponding supraharmonic frequency and amplitude are determined according to the calculation results. The accuracy and validity of the algorithm are proved by the measurement of supraharmonic charging piles of electric vehicles (EVs). The method in this paper can provide a prerequisite scientific measurement basis for the further study of the generation mechanism and suppression of supraharmonic.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of Under Frequency Load Shedding Schemes for Systems with High Permeability New Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper analyzes the influence of high permeability new energy on the frequency characteristics of the system, and proposes a multi-objective optimization model for under frequency load shedding (UFLS), which takes the proportions of load shedding of each round as the optimization variables. A multi-objective optimization model is established, in which mean frequency deviation and load shedding amount are considered as objectives. And the system dynamic frequency and load shedding of each round are set as constraints. An example of the 10 machines 39-nodes system shows that the proposed scheme can make the system have better frequency stability and reduce load shedding.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Terminal Unit for Power Distribution Automation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to mitigate the cost of manpower and resource in maintenance of power distribution assets, and to deal with the inefficiency caused by the separated protection / automation system and maintenance / management system , a 4-in-1 intelligent terminal unit is proposed, which combines the functions of protection, measurement and control, online monitoring, and maintenance. It covers all the functions of a conventional distribution automation terminal unit and additionally provide maintenance functions based on multi-dimensional analysis to the online monitoring data collected through multiple sensors for temperature, mechanical characteristics, contacts movements, etc.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Distribution Network Intelligent Operation Inspection Management and Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the development of modern science and technology, through real-time and continuous tracking and monitoring of distribution network equipment, analysis of historical data, introduction of neural network calculation and cloud big object intelligence transfer technology, it provides basic support for the application and research of intelligent operation and inspection management and control system of distribution network, such as state evaluation, intelligent error prevention, intelligent dispatch orders, and so on, so as to improve the overall level of distribution network construction, development, operation and maintenance. To realize full information monitoring of equipment status.

articleTitle: Research on the Efficiency and Influence Factors of Resistance Reducing Agent in Transmission line Grounding Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The tower grounding grid is an important lightning protection facility for transmission lines, with the using of resistance reducing agent, the transmission line lightning protection engineering is often faced with blind construction, poor long effectiveness and other technical bottlenecks. In this paper, the effectiveness and influence factors of resistance reducing agent are analyzed particularly. Firstly, The influence of different reducing agent usage on reducing efficiency is analyzed through the results of multi-group calculation of the model of the slotted type and the square with radial type. Then, the influence of the material parameters of different reducing agent and the laying position on grounding resistance of grounding grid are analyzed. After that, the effect of grounding grid area and soil resistivity on resistance reducing agent are simulated. At last, according to the simulation results, the proposed construction suggestions are proposed for the actual transmission line grounding grid resistance reducing with the resistance reducing agent . The research contents can provide a theoretical reference for the transmission line lightning protection and power system grounding field.

Author Keywords: construction methods of grounding resistance reducing.

articleTitle: Research on Arc Model of Disconnector for Conduction Interference of Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: When disconnector operate capacitive small currents, it will produce strong high frequency transient electromagnetic interference, which will cause damage to electronic transformer. In this paper, a dynamic arc model of disconnector is established. by using TACS element in ATP-EMTP. Referring to the standard GB/T 1985-2014, the test circuit of disconnector switch operation is established. Combining with the dynamic arc model, the maximum current amplitude of high frequency transient electromagnetic interference is 576A, the maximum voltage amplitude is 1.8p.u, and the transient current frequency is up to 210kHz. The corresponding experimental circuit is established, and the waveform of high frequency voltage and current generated by disconnector operation is obtained. By comparing the measured and simulated transient waveforms, it is found that the transient current and voltage changes are in accordance with each other, which verifies the correctness of the arc model.

articleTitle: A Wide Output Non-Isolated Boost-Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the rapid development of new energy power generation, energy storage, electric vehicles and microgrid, the DC voltage generated by single power source is relatively low in the process of power conversion. It is necessary to add a DC converter at the front end of the system to improve the utilization rate of DC voltage. Aiming at the problems of traditional DC converter, such as small voltage conversion range and large switching loss. In this paper, a wide output non-isolated Buck-Boost converter topology is proposed. The new topology uses only two fully-controlled transistors as the main switch, featuring a simple topology and flexible control mode. At the same time, it has a wide voltage conversion range in terms of output performance and a voltage gain much higher than that of a conventional Buck-Boost converter. The occurrence of high voltage gain at extreme duty cycle is avoided, such as 44 times of voltage gain can be obtained when the duty cycle is 0.8. Finally, the rationality of the proposed Buck-Boost converter topology and the correctness of theoretical analysis are verified by constructing an experimental prototype.

articleTitle: Design of point contact arc generator based on closed-loop control
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The operating characteristics of Arc Fault Detection Devices (AFDD) relate to the safety of people's lives and property closely. During the test of the operating characteristics for AFDDs, it is found that the success rate during the series arc test is low, and the point contact arc generator could not produce the arcing time that meets the requirements of the national standard. In response to this phenomenon, this paper discusses the standard of low-voltage fault arc test, the collection of arcing data, and the design of test circuit, etc. The idea of closed-loop control is introduced into the point contact arc generator device; the development of the device is completed. The test results show that the device can generate the arcing time that meets the requirements of the national standard with high quality, and the test success rate of operating characteristic for AFDDs is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Dynamic Price Optimization Strategy for Charging Power Station with Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Reasonable price strategy is of great significance to the safe and economic operation of a microgrid. To reduce the power exchange fluctuation between the main grid and a microgrid and to enhance the profit of a microgrid, a dynamic price strategy based on modified particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed. Then, a multi-objective optimization model considering the income of a microgrid and load fluctuation of distribution network is presented. To validate the proposed price strategy and the optimization model, a series of numerical simulations are conducted to demonstrate their effect on the power exchange fluctuation and the profit of the microgrid. The result shows that the proposed dynamic price strategy markedly increases the profit of the microgrid and strengthen the effect on power peak shaving and valley filling compared with time-of-use(TOU) price strategy and the fixed electricity price strategy.

articleTitle: HIL simulation for the closure process of contactors based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The theoretical analysis for the closure process of contactors is carried out, and the finite element method is used to verify the one-to-one correspondence among the parameters of the electromagnetic system. By the theory of neural network, a function of the coil current is constructed. The attraction and counterforce formulas of electromagnetism system are combined to realize the contactor virtualization. The virtual contactor with an actual controller and a driving circuit form the intelligent contactor hardware-in-loop (HIL) simulation system. The simulation results are verified via the current closed-loop control strategy. The HIL simulation system provides an efficient and safe environment for the development and verification of the contactor intelligent control strategy.

articleTitle: Waveform Characteristic Analysis and Recognition of Short-circuit Fault in Grid-connected AC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: To detect and locate the short-circuit fault area quickly and accurately in the microgrid can reduce its impact on the large power grid under grid-connected mode. Therefore, it is necessary to study the waveform characteristics of short-circuit fault current in the microgrid under grid-connected mode. In this paper, a short-circuit fault simulation model is established in PSCAD. And the current information is monitored at the connection points between feeders and common bus of microgrid. Wavelet energy spectrum algorithm is used to analyze the detected current waveforms, and the characteristics of current waveforms are studied when various types of short-circuit faults occur. The simulation results show that the high-scale wavelet energy spectrum transform algorithm can identify and extract fault features, which provides a theoretical basis for the fast detection and location of short-circuit faults in microgrid in the future.

articleTitle: A Novel Integrated Transformer Structure for High Efficiency LLC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The high-efficiency, high-current and low-cost power solutions are required for data centers application, in order to reduce the transmission loss on cables, the high input-voltage dc distribution power architecture has been adopted, the 380-12 V high output current isolated converter is widely used in this application. This paper presents a 300-kHz 1-kW LLC resonant converter using novel integrated transformer and Gallium nitride device that are designed and optimized for the LLC resonant converter. The novel integrated transformer structure is proposed and designed for reducing core-loss, secondary conduction-loss and achieving no gap-loss. In the end, a laboratory prototype is designed and tested. The experimental results have verified the performance of the proposed LLC resonant converter with novel integrated transformer.

articleTitle: Technical and Economic Analysis of ACCC Applied in UHV-DC Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to improve the efficient and safe of transmission lines to transmit electrical energy, new energy-saving type wires have emerged. Among them, the aluminum conductor with reinforced core of carbon fiber (ACCC) wire has the advantages of high current carrying capacity, low sag, corrosion resistance, high tensile strength, etc., and is economically effective in the transmission line. However, it is mainly used in the capacity expansion and transformation of the power grid, and the economics of its application in Ultra high voltage (UHV) DC transmission line needs to be further studied. In this paper, the annual cost method is used to analyze the electrical performance, mechanical properties and economy of ACCC and conventional aluminum conductor steel-reinforced (ACSR) wire. The life cycle cost of two wires when erected at various possible spans of 100 meters are obtained. It provides a theoretical basis for the application of ACCC in UHV DC transmission lines.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimal Configuration of Current Limiter in HVDC Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Voltage source converter based on the high voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) has become a research hotspot in the field of HVDC due to its flexibility and reliability. However, the short circuit current of DC power grid becomes larger when the short circuit fault occurs. How to remove the fault on the DC side quickly becomes a research difficulty in the technology of DC power transmission. This paper focuses on the optimal configuration of current limiters in FHVDC systems. Firstly, this paper analyzes the faults in the flexible DC power grid by taking the current studied superconducting current limiter as an example. Then, based on the characteristics of the superconducting current limiter, an optimization approach of the current limiter is proposed, which considers the cutoff capacity and fault response time of the DC circuit breaker. Finally, an example is selected to verify the optimization method on the MATLAB platform. The simulation results show that the optimal configuration method can effectively guide the design of the current limiter and improve its economy in the application process.

articleTitle: Coordinated optimization scheduling of wind power, photovoltaic, photo-thermal and hydropower considering the schedulability of photo-thermal power stations
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: By analyzing the randomness and intermittentity of wind power output and PV power plant output and the schedulability of CSP (Concentrating Solar Power) power generation, a coordinated optimal scheduling strategy for wind power, photovoltaic, photothermal and hydropower is proposed. Based on the system integration benefit maximization, the target optimization function is constructed, and the fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) with elite strategy is used to optimize the objective function. The simulation results show that the wind power, photovoltaic and hydropower output are matched with the photothermal peaking characteristics, and the coordinated operation of wind power, photovoltaic, photothermal and hydropower coordination improves the economics of wind power, photovoltaic, photothermal and hydropower generation systems. Abandoning the wind and reducing the light, effectively improving the efficiency of grid connection. This verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Bridgeless Dual Boost PFC Converter with Power Decoupling Based on Model Predictive Current Control
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to reduce the low-frequency output voltage ripple of the bridgeless dual Boost PFC converter, a boost-type bidirectional dc/dc power decoupling circuit is used, the circuit working principle is analyzed. A model predictive current control(MPCC) controller is adopted to control the inductor current of the power decoupling circuit, the MPCC is improved to reduce the error caused by digital control precision. A 1000W simulation experiment is carried out, the theoretical analysis is verified, the inherent ripple power in the ac grid source is transferred to the power decoupling branch.

articleTitle: Novel Space-Vector Pulse-Width-Modulation Mechanism for Three-Level Neutral-Point-Clamped Z-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this study, a novel space-vector pulse-width-modulation (SVPWM) mechanism is proposed for a three-level neutral-point clamped (NPC) Z-source inverter (ZSI) via the line-voltage coordinate system. In order to solve the problems of the adjustment of the complicated operational region and the complex computation of look-up tables in conventional methods, the newly-designed SVPWM mechanism is developed from the basis of the vector synthesis. With this mechanism, switching vectors required to synthesize the reference vector can be easily identified, and the corresponding duty ratios can be directly obtained. The effectiveness of the proposed SVPWM mechanism is verified by numerical simulations. The salient features of the proposed SVPWM method are easiness in digital implementation, less execution time and better power quality in comparison with the traditional SVPWM scheme.

articleTitle: Electric Power Balancing Optimization Considering Thermal Units in Peak-regulating Ancillary Service Market
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: To tackle the peak regulation issue caused by large-scale renewable energy integration, a multi-regional power balancing model is established in this paper considering thermal units involving in peak-regulating ancillary service market. In addition, considering the slow and ineffective solution of current sequential operation simulation in power system, the sequential decomposition technique with overlapping period and automatic rollback mechanism for insolvable case are adopted to considerately accelerate the annual sequential operation simulation. The test on the Northeast China Power Grid verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model and solving method.

articleTitle: Impacts of SVG Location and Capacity on Voltage Recovery Characteristics in Hunan Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The dynamic voltage stability, which often occurs in the load center, is a key factor that restricts the economic operation of power systems and threatens the development and safe operation of power systems. Comparing to the power electronic devices, traditional reactive power compensations such as synchronous condenser, low-voltage capacitor and reactance have less technical and economic advantages and hard to support systems rapid development. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the application of new dynamic reactive power compensation technology, namely static var generator (SVG), in practical power systems. Developing distributed SVGs for grid dynamic voltage support is of great technical and economic value. Therefore, this paper takes Hunan network as an example to investigate the effect of SVGs location and capacity on transient voltage recovery characteristics. Time-domain simulation results are carried out from the PSASP. From the simulation cases, it is shown that the case with distributed SVGs has a better effect on the voltage recovery than the centralized SVG. However, the simulation results also show that different SVG capacity, location and the load level will lead to different optimal configuration of distributed SVG. A further research is needed in the following future.

articleTitle: A Review of Power Electronic Parametric Fault Diagnosis Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper attempts to present a concise review of the research done around parametric fault diagnosis methods for power electronic circuits, including model-based, knowledge-based, signal-based and other emerging fusion methods. Comments on the advantages and constraints of various methods, are also given. Finally, combined with the bottlenecks faced by the current parametric fault diagnosis field of power electronic circuits, the new trends of future research in this field are discussed.

articleTitle: Evolution from a Door Bell into an IP Door Phone
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This work introduces a general view on an evolution of door communication systems. The work evaluates a current market of IP-based systems which currently consists mainly of more expensive devices targeted on business customers. The goal is to design a doorphone prototype based on an IP protocol with suitable functions and easy control for a less demanding user. The Raspberry Pi computer was chosen for development together with other suitable hardware to accomplish desired functions. The Linphone open-source project was used to implement phone functionality. The low price or open-source solutions were preferred when selecting ideal hardware and software to use. The conclusion evaluates how successful the implementation was while keeping the device affordable.

articleTitle: Discussion on Operation State Evaluation of Low Voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The distribution network is one of the important links of power transmission, and the low-voltage distribution network is the last link in the distribution network. It is directly connected to the load and delivers the power of the upper-level power supply to the load. Therefore, the low-voltage distribution network directly affects Grid operating status. This paper introduces the six important index parameters in the low-voltage distribution network evaluation system in detail, and summarizes the application and advantages of the low-voltage distribution network operation status assessment method. Finally, the future development of distribution network operation status assessment is prospected.

articleTitle: A High-gain Floating-Interleaved Three-level Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: To meet the high gain and high power of DC/DC converters, a high-gain floating-interleaved three-level boost converter (TL-FIBC) is proposed in this paper. The converter is composed of two three-level boost converters connected in a floating interleaved manner, which make the high gain as well as low input current ripple realized. Thus, The TL-FIBC can be used as the front stage boost part of the photovoltaic power generation system. In addition, because of the three-level structure is adopted in the internal subunits of the TL-FIBC, the voltage stress of switch is only one quarter of the sum of input voltage and output voltage. The operation principle is introduced firstly, then the gain characteristics of the proposed converter are investigated in depth. Afterwards, the control of flying capacitor voltage is adopted to make the voltages of the flying capacitor of upper and lower subunits equal respectively. Finally, a 2.5kW prototype with 68 120V input and 700V output is built, and the feasibility of the TL-FIBC and the correctness of theoretical analysis are verified.

articleTitle: Operation Mode and Economic Analysis of Concentrating Solar Power Station
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Concentrating Solar Power (CSP) is a new energy generation technology, which has received extensive attention in recent years. The research on the field level of Concentrating Solar power station is a difficult and hot topic in the research of Concentrating Solar power station at present, In this paper, the energy transfer process and heat transfer. Their basic operation models and economic models are established respectively. The results show that the efficiency and stability of CSP power station can be improved by improving the concentrating ability of the concentrating solar field, the utilization ratio of the heat storage tank and the thermal conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: A Robust Planning Considering Multiple Uncertainties of Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With a large number of uncertain distributed power supply access to the distribution network, increasing multiple uncertainties in distribution networks brings new challenges to its planning. Considering the uncertainty of load and wind speed, this paper proposes a robust planning method considering multiple uncertainties for distribution network. Firstly, based on life cycle cost and robust optimization, a two- layer robust planning model considering multiple uncertainties is constructed. Then the upper planning scheme is verified with the worst scenario. Finally, the IEEE33 node is used for simulation analysis. Simulation results based on standard example verify the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Docker-Based Cloud Platform for Smart Medicine Box
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the improvement of medical conditions, people have higher requirements for health. Chronic diseases are a type of disease with extremely high mortality. Studies have shown that scientific medication has a positive effect on the prevention and treatment of chronic diseases, and smart medicine boxes provide conditions for scientific medication. In order to improve the management of smart medicine boxes and offer a remote monitoring platform, this paper uses Docker technology to design a cloud platform. Through the Docker container technology, the cloud platform device registration, database storage and back-end programs are implemented in the form of micro-services, which effectively improves the platform's own expansion capabilities. Experimental tests show that the platform can effectively monitory smart medicine boxes and have certain development capabilities.

articleTitle: Anti-misoperation Scheme for Large Power Grid Based on Topology Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The application of substation sequential control puts forward new requirements for anti-misoperation. This paper presents a new anti-misoperation scheme for large power grid based on network topology algorithm. Using the network topology algorithm, the three operating states of the substation primary equipment, such as charging, power failure and grounding, can be calculated in real time. The three-state topology model and calculation steps are given, and the analysis algorithm is applied according to the five-proof judgment. The network topology calculation is used to judge the misoperation. It has the characteristics of simple logic locking rules and convenient implementation. Because it adopts common anti-missing judgment, it can effectively avoid the problem of leakage setting or incorrect setting of the operation blocking rule.

articleTitle: Research on Induced voltage and Current in Deenergized Line of Double-Circuit Transmission Lines on the Same Tower
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The double-circuit transmission lines on the same tower can not only reduce the overall cost invest and line corridor demand, but also increase the transmission capacity per unit line, while also meeting the demand for power transmission. However, in the double-circuit transmission line on the same tower, when one is power-off or overhauled, and other circuit energized operation, the induced voltage and induced current will be generated on the overhauled line, which brings great security risks to the construction and maintenance personnel. The induced voltage and induced current on the double-return transmission line of the same tower were investigated. The theoretical calculation method and ATP-EMTP model for induced voltage and induced current on the deenergized line of double-circuits transmission lines were brieflyintroduced.And influencing factors of induced voltage and induced current on the deenergized circuit of double-circuit transmission lines on the same tower were calculated. The analysis results indicatedshows that the line length, conductor spacing, voltage level and soil resistivity of the multi-circuit transmission line on the same tower had a great influence on the induced voltage and induced current, which had important reference value for the subsequent research on double-circuit transmission lines on the same tower.

Author Keywords: multiple towers in the same tower

articleTitle: Sliding Mode Control Based Direct Power Control and Equivalent Space Vector Modulation of Three-Switched Two-Level Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to eliminate the defect of conventional PI controller which is too sensitive to the variation of system parameters, a direct power control (DPC) strategy based on sliding mode variable structure was presented, the DPC mathematics model of three-switch two-level rectifier was developed in detail, and the proposed control system diagram was derivated in deta il and the realized method was shown in this paper. In addition, aiming at the complex space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM), a simplified equivalent SVPWM based on the carried-based pulse width modulation was proposed for this topology. The paper combined DPC scheme based on sliding mode control (SMC) and equivalent SVPWM technique together to achieve a constant switching frequency and the midpoint potential balance, while the rectifier works with unity power factor and reduces the switching losses. Finally, the MATLAB/Simulink model based on three-switch two-level rectifier was built, the results illustrated that the combined strategy was easy to design and implement with possessing good robustness and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: A Ripple-Based DC-DC Buck Converter with Random Switching Frequency
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In general, the step-down switching power converter is prone to excessive electromagnetic interference on the input side. The constant on-time controlled buck converter with random switching frequency proposed in this paper is mainly characterized by not using external components. In this case, the spread spectrum mechanism is used to reduce the electromagnetic interference (EMI) of the converter itself, and the power stage output capacitor of the converter can use the ceramic capacitor of the low equivalent series resistance to reduce the output voltage ripple. The chip was realized with TSMC 0.18μm 1P6M CMOS process, and the chip area including the PAD is 1.2 × 1.15 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The input voltage range is 2.9~3.3V and the output voltage is 1.8V. The switching convertor operated at 1-MHz switching frequency and performed spread-spectrum modulation. The external inductor and capacitor are 3.3μH and 10μF, respectively.

articleTitle: Hybrid Control Strategy of DC-DC Converters Based on Admissible Edge-Dependent Average Dwell Time
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this study, a novel switching rule is designed for DC-DC converters that drive the state of the switched dynamic system to a desired equilibrium point. Utilizing the notion of admissible edge-dependent average dwell time(AED-ADT), the proposed control law handle the chattering problem on the operating point, limit high frequency and decrease the switching loss. The results are given in terms of linear matrix inequalities(LMI). The efficiency of the proposed method is illustrated by simulation.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Single-phase Voltage Source Converters Based on Linearization Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Three-phase voltage source converters (VSCs) are commonly applied to power electronic system and their stability is analyzed in the frequency domain. However, the stability analysis of single-phase VSCs is rare and the frequency domain modeling is complex. In this paper, a time domain nonlinear dynamic average modeling in dq-frame is proposed. First, a system model is established according to single-phase VSCs circuit. Then, the stability analysis of single-phase VSCs with two different linearization theories are tried and completed. Finally, the MATLAB/Simulink model of single-phase VSC is built and simulation results can verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatching of CCHP Microgrid Considering Grid-connected Revenue
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In view of the fact that combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) microgrid can effectively improve the permeability of clean energy and reduce the cost of micro-sources, an economic dispatching model for the CCHP microgrid is established in this paper. The model is aimed at minimizing the cost of power generation and environmental governance under the premise of considering the highest grid-connected revenue. Multi-agent chaotic particle swarm optimization(MACPSO) algorithm is used to solve the model to obtain the optimal solution and the optimal output schemes of micro-sources. Finally, one CCHP microgrid in China is selected for simulation as case study to analyze the influence of microgrid joining CCHP system under grid-connection conditions on the optimization results. Then, the MACPSO algorithm is applied to obtain the optimal solution of the total generation cost, and the reliability of the proposed method is verified by comparative analysis.

articleTitle: Do Real Life Visuals Help Students to Learn Engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Learning engineering can be challenging with concepts interwoven with mathematics. When new academics start teaching a class, existing materials are often utilized without due consideration of the changing world and the utilization of new technology to improve teaching material. A new 3R model (Relate, Re-image, Re-design) is developed to redesign engineering tutorials with real world visuals. This model has been implemented for three continuous years to a similar cohort of third year undergraduate electrical engineering students in a leading technical university in Australia. With the model, real life visuals have been incorporated, e.g. building rooftop solar systems, technical challenges to customers and grid. Its impact has been anonymously evaluated with university off-class online surveys. Results show students' understanding, confidence and engagement have been improved significantly. This model enhances engineering curriculum with blended and authentic learning experiences. It also assists in the professional development of new academics.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Field Distribution and Protection Technology of Live line Workers on ±500kV Flexible DC Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Taking the transmission line in Zhangbei flexible project as the research object, ANSYS software was used to construct the electric field simulation model of DC ±500kV single-circuit, live working personnel of the same tower double-circuit transmission line under typical working conditions, and the typical entry into the selection. The electric field and potential of the human body surface at the site were calculated, and the influence of the return line on the electric field and potential distribution of the body surface of the charged workers was analyzed. The results show that the body surface electric field values of the head, hand and foot parts are large (maximum 697kV/m), and the shielded clothing with 60dB shielding efficiency should be worn from the ground potential into the equipotential. the spatial electric field of the double-circuit transmission line on the same tower and the electric field of the human body surface at some calculation points are affected, but the distribution of space potential and human body potential has little effect. The research results can provide reference for the research and standardization of safety protection technology for live workers. The spatial electric field distribution in the double-circuit line on the same tower converges toward the return line; the electric field at the position 1 and position 5 is larger than the electric field at the same position in the double-circuit line without the return line, at position 3 and position 7 are smaller than, but have little effect on space potential and human body potential; The research results can provide reference for the research and standardization of safety protection technology for live workers.

Author Keywords: multiple towers on the same tower

articleTitle: Collaborative Regulation Control Optimization on Demand Side of Microgrid Based on Multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to make the components in microgrid operate stably and improve the economic benefits, multi-agent technology is adopted to coordinate the control of load, storage battery on demand side and micro-sources on generation side. In this way, the communication information among agents in the microgrid can be feedback promptly and the system operation failure can be reduced. Then, a battery charging and discharging control strategy is proposed based on the real-time electricity price mechanism for grid-connected microgrid.
