The output power characteristics of the battery are analyzed to coordinate the output of each micro-source at different times of a day. Meanwhile, a multi-agent chaotic particle swarm optimization (MACPSO) algorithm is used to solve the economic operation model of microgrid considering user satisfaction. Finally, through the comparative analysis of examples, it is verified that the proposed microgrid based on multi-agent coordinated control can effectively improve the operation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Coal Price Fluctuation on Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Thermal power generation plays a pivotal role in China's energy system. At present, China's coal prices are dominated by the market, and electricity prices are regulated by the government. Therefore, a series of contradictions will occur between the market-led coal prices and the government-regulated electricity prices. Under the above conditions, this paper regards coal price as the decisive factor affecting electricity price, taking the financial profit of power plant as the starting point, first analyzes the factors affecting coal price, and then introduces the current development mode of power grid price of power plant in China; based on the above analysis, coal-electric linkage early warning model was designed. Finally, the feasibility and practicability of the model are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Novel indicator system and evaluation strategy for charging security of electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In recent years, electric vehicles show explosive growth. Evaluation of electric vehicle charging security is of great significance for power grid and electric vehicles. This paper firstly establishes a comprehensive indicator system for electric vehicle charging security from three aspects, which consisted of power grid security, charging facility security and communication security. Then, a new security evaluation strategy is put forward. Concretely, analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method and entropy weight (EW) method are introduced to get reasonable weights of each indicator. After that, via the correlation degree index obtained by the grey correlation analysis (GRA) method, evaluation principles of the security level of EV charging are put forward. Finally, based on two different cases, the effectiveness of the proposed indicator system and evaluation strategy is verified.

articleTitle: Integration of Wideband and Narrowband Communication in Power Wireless Private Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Wireless communication technologies are well developed in recent years and are widely used in different applications. In the energy Internet of Things, cellular communication is the key to connect all the power devices in the world. For the consideration of reliable and security, TD-LTE based power wireless private network is already under construction in China. The power wireless private network is aiming to support current and future power services, both wideband services and narrowband services. The current power wireless private network with carrier frequency of 230 MHz is narrowband communication which is established by Potevio. In order to supporting both wideband and narrowband services in one system with limited changes on current network, we proposed a solution to integrate multiple narrowband devices in physical to realize the wideband services transmission.

articleTitle: Multi-core Parallel Processing Technique for Short-circuit Computation of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Multi-core parallel computation technique is introduced for fault analysis of power systems. The detailed procedure is provided on how to apply the multi-core parallel computation to decompose and solve the node based matrix for short-circuit computation. The comparative analysis based on a simple power system is completed. Furthermore, the tests based on actual central China grid are conducted, and the comparison between the multi-core parallel computation and clustering computation is made. The results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Calculation of Absorbed Energy of ZnO Arrester for DC Circuit Breaker in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: DC distribution network has become the development trend of power distribution system in the future due to its flexible control, high stability and good power quality. As a protection device for DC distribution network, DC circuit breaker is of great significance to the stability and safety of DC distribution network. In this paper, based on the existing DC hybrid circuit breaker circuit topology, the voltage and current of the DC circuit breaker ZnO energy absorbing element during the breaking of different fault currents are calculated. Therefore, the energy that needs to be absorbed by the ZnO energy absorbing element during the breaking process is calculated. The results of this paper can be used to guide the selection of the ZnO arrester in the DC circuit breaker, thereby improving the breaking capacity and reliability of the DC circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Effect of Al doping on nonlinearity and residual voltage of ZnO ceramic resistor
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: ZnO arresters are widely used in DC circuit breakers to absorb energy in the process of breaking short-circuit fault currents because of their excellent current carrying capability and excellent nonlinearity. In this paper, some samples of ZnO ceramic resistors with different electrical properties were prepared by changing the doping amount of Al content. The I-V characteristics of the sample were tested. By studying the I-V curve, the grain resistance and the voltage at the grain boundary were calculated. The relationship between nonlinearity and and residual voltage is obtained. It is considered that the residual voltage is affected not only by the residual voltage of the grain but also by the breakdown voltage of the grain boundary.

articleTitle: Using A Smart Plug based on Consumer Electronics to Support Low Power Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, a design of modular plug that serves as an end-device within smart home environment is proposed. The plug is comprised of several components, namely: communication module, relay sensors, driver, power converter, and microcontroller. The components are packed into a compact and lightweight form that fulfills consumer electronics standards. To monitor and control the plug, a companion Android application is also developed to serve as wireless switch. The plug's functional test shows the device is able to operate using 49.9 mA current in idle mode and 123.7 mA in active mode for 5 VDC input, thus making it suitable for smart home infrastructure aimed for energy conservation purposes.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Environment Humidity to Power Frequency Electric Field Measuring Result with Suspended Probe
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Power frequency electric field is a key factor of electromagnetic environment of AC transmission and transformation project. And the measuring result of suspended probe may rather larger with high environment humidity. In this paper, some experimental in the climate laboratory was completed to make clear the how environment humidity affect the measuring result. The experimental results indicate that the environment humidity has great impact to the measuring result of suspended probe. Meanwhile, the environment humidity can make the space electric field distorting through the holder. Hence, the measurement in high-humidity environment is not applicable for environment assessments.

articleTitle: Feature selection of Complex Power Quality Disturbances and Parameter Optimization of Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: A hybrid method based on modified discrete artificial bee colony algorithm(MDABC) for power quality disturbance(PQD) signal feature selection and parameter optimization of random forest(RF) is proposed. Firstly, time-frequency features of the complex power quality disturbance signal are extracted using s-transform(ST) to form an original feature set; Then, by using default parameters of RF, the out-of-bag(OOB) Permutation test value of each feature in the original feature set is calculated as the feature weight, and the features of the training and verification data set are rearranged in descending order accordingly. Finally, taking the generalization error of RF as the objective function, the forest scale: nTree, the number of input features:Ni and the node feature subset size:q are optimized using MDABC to determine the optimal parameters of RF and the optimal feature set. It can be seen from the experiment that compared with the RF classifier before optimization, the accuracy of the MDABC-RF classifier in the classification of 16 and 19 complex PQD signals is better, and its operating efficiency is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of On-Load Voltage and Capacity Regulation of 10kV New Energy-Saving Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to adapt to the trend of distribution network to be intelligent, efficient and green, Guangdong Power Grid has successfully developed a new type of dry-type transformer with high energy saving and reliability. As the key equipment of voltage and capacity control, its dynamic characteristics can not be ignored. In this paper, the working principle of on-load voltage regulation and capacity regulation of 10kV new high energy-saving dry-type transformer is analyzed theoretically. In addition, the simulation model is built based on the electromagnetic transient simulation software PSCAD/EMTDC, and the influence of voltage regulation and capacitance regulation process on voltage stability is simulated and analyzed. Relevant conclusions can provide theoretical support for the promotion and adjustment strategy formulation of the new distribution transformer.

articleTitle: A Sliding Model Controller Improved with RBF Neural Network for Hydro-turbine Governing System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to promote the operation stability of hydro-turbine, an improved controlling model with fully fusion of RBF neural network and sliding mode control (RBF-SMC) is proposed in the paper. In view of buffeting problem existing in traditional Sliding mode variable structure control, the proposed control method is achieved by designing sliding surface and the derivative of sliding surface as input of RBF neural network while output of RBF neural network as switching control, so as to realize the online adjustment of sliding mode control law. Further, the method can effectively attenuate buffeting phenomenon by utilizing strong nonlinear approximation ability and adaptive capability of RBF neural network. In order to verify superiority of the proposed method, the controlling experiment of a hydro-turbine governing system is conducted under two different running conditions. The results indicate that the performance of the proposed RBF-SMC control method is superior to the traditional PID control method and SMC control method, which has better robustness and adaptability for the hydro-turbine governing system, while effectively weakens buffeting.

articleTitle: Multiple Input-Terminal Voltage Multiplier Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Voltage multipliers (VMs) are widely used not only in high voltage gain rectifier applications but also some traditional dc/dc converters to improve voltage conversion ratio. However, as the fixed number of its input-terminals, it is hard to traditional VM circuits to make a balance between the voltage and current stress on capacitors. In order to address such drawback of traditional VMs, a multiple input-terminal VM (MIVM) circuit is presented in this paper. The design flexibility of the proposed MIVM is better than traditional VMs. Analysis of the operation principles and the performance characteristics of the proposed MIVM circuit are presented in detail. And the efficacy of the theoretical analysis is validated experimentally.

articleTitle: Design of High-Efficiency Single-Input Triple-Outputs DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This study mainly develops a high-efficiency single-input triple-outputs dc/dc converter (HSTDC) with soft-switching technique for high step-up applications. In general, multiple output voltages with only one single input power source is always required for the applications of renewable energy or electric vehicles. At the high step-up operation, the proposed HSTDC has a high voltage conversion ratio to sustain the high-voltage dc bus for the utilization of dc/ac inverter. The proposed HSTDC uses a coupled inductor with lower turn ratios to achieve the high step-up voltage gain, and adopts an auxiliary inductor to adjust the voltage of the auxiliary output terminal indirectly. Moreover, the utilization of voltage clamping and zero-current switching (ZCS) in the proposed HSTDC is helpful for accomplishing the goal of high-efficiency power conversion and three output voltage levels. In addition, the effectiveness of the proposed HSTDC is verified by rich experimental results.

articleTitle: An Indicator Reduction Method for Contactor’s Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: There are some disadvantages which are numerous and varied indicators, and thus high equipment costs in existing AC contactors' closing dynamic performance evaluation. Based on gray correlation & cluster theory, this paper proposed a new method to reduce the number of indicators for contactor's performance evaluation. It took one existing indicator set proposed by Hebei University of Technology for example. Firstly, the existing 21 indicators are clustered to three types: important, complementary and dispensable. Secondly, nine different and typical indicator sets including the these types are proposed. Nine samples' closing performance are evaluated respectively by gray clustering & correlation theory. The better indicator set is ascertained by aiming at the same performance classification and ranking. Finally, the identified set is verified with the combined method based on gray correlation and technique for order preference by similarity to an ideal solution(TOPSIS) theories, and the method of indicator reduction is proved to be feasible and the number of the original indicator is reduced from 21 to 13. It will be helpful for indicator reducing, cost saving and shortening the evaluation process. Moreover, it will provide theoretical basis for dynamic process control and choosing best phase angles in life test for intelligent contactors, and it will provide references for choosing appropriate indicators for other similar electrical products' evaluation.

articleTitle: PV reactive voltage regional autonomy control strategy for Q(U) improvement in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to solve the voltage over-limit problem of photovoltaic grid-connected, the inverter's reactive power output is adjusted to reduce the voltage limit. By analyzing the limitations of typical PV reactive voltage control methods, a modified Q(U)-based PV reactive voltage regional autonomous control strategy is proposed. This strategy sets the voltage threshold based on dynamic voltage and power information and divides the operating region. The Q (U) control strategy is used to calculate the PV reactive output target value, and the inverter is controlled to meet the reactive power output requirement. The simulation analysis results show that the method can solve the problem of voltage over-limit of photovoltaic access.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Operation of Wind Power-Pumped Storage Joint System Based on Improved Bat Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the problem of fluctuation of wind power output, the optimal operation model of wind power-pumped storage joint system considering the output fluctuation is established. With scale expansion of the joint system model, the conventional algorithm may have certain limitations. Therefore, according to the characteristics of bat algorithm with dealing with high dimension, multiple constraints, the bat algorithm can be applied to the joint optimization operation of wind power-pumped storage joint system. This paper proposes an improved bat algorithm. The results show that the joint operation of wind power-pumped storage can effectively stabilize wind power output fluctuation when the improved bat algorithm is used. The convergence speed and optimization precision is obviously improved comparing improved bat algorithm with basic bat algorithm and PSO algorithm.

articleTitle: The influence of STATCOM Operation on Voltage Stability of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: STATCOM is a typical reactive power regulating equipment, which is more and more widely used in provincial power grid. In this paper, ZX and SD stations will invest in STATCOM with rated capacity of 120 Mvar as an example. Including the ontology characteristics of STATCOM and its impact on the power grid after it is put into operation. The analysis results can be used to evaluate the influence of STATCOM on the voltage security and stability of provincial power grid in practical application.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lightning Strike Characteristics and Electromagnetic Environment of Wind Turbine Blades
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Wind turbine blade is the most vulnerable part of wind turbine to lightning damage. Its lightning resistance directly determines the lightning protection technology of wind turbine. Therefore, it is extremely important to study the wind turbine blades' electromagnetic environment and lightning strike characteristics under lightning guidance. Based on the analysis of the traditional rules algorithm, the influence factors of the lightning strike characteristics of wind turbines are obtained. It is clear that the procedure method calculates the number of lightning strikes without considering the lightning current amplitude, the highest point of the wind turbine and the unidentified up and down lightning strikes. Based on this, the existing lightning leader development model is introduced to reveal the charge distribution of the downlink lightning leader channel with different lightning currents. Then, based on the simulated charge method and the quasi-static method, the algorithm for solving the spatial electric field distribution of the wind turbine blade under the lightning leader development model is proposed. Finally, the electromagnetic field distribution characteristics at different heights under blade rotation conditions are obtained. The calculation results of Jinfeng 77/1500 wind turbine show that the surface electric field distribution characteristics of the blades are improved significantly after the installation of the lightning receptors. It is also recommended that the best installation position of the lightning receptor be 1m from the tip of the wind turbine blade.

articleTitle: Security Constrained Unit Commitment Considering Time Shift of Air-conditioning Load for Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: A new method is proposed for the security constrained unit commitment considering the time shift of air-conditioning load as a demand response strategy participating in the power system to reduce the ramping demand. Firstly, the mathematical model of the air-conditioning load is introduced. Then, a time shift model of the air-conditioning load is proposed. At last, security constrained unit commitment considering the time shift of air-conditioning load is established. Simulation results demonstrate the advantage of considering the time shift of air-conditioning load for demand response that can reduce the ramping demand and improve the economics of the power system.

articleTitle: Study on Resistance Reduction Efficiency of Grounding Module in Transmission Tower Grounding Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The auxiliary material is often used to reduce the resistance of transmission line tower grounding grid for the limitation of the extension and vertical grounding resistance reduction measures. For the lack of unified standard guidance when grounding modules are used in the actual tower grounding project, some problems occurred in application such as blind construction and low reduction efficiency. In this paper, the common lightning protection software CDEGS is used to simulate and calculate the influencing factors when grounding module is used to reduce the resistance of transmission line tower grounding grid. First of all, simulation is carried out for the laying position and density of the grounding module in the "one" shaped grounding grid. Secondly, the efficiency of grounding module in the grounding grid is analyzed through the simulation. Then, the influence rule of soil resistivity and soil structure on the grounding module reduction efficiency is analyzed. Finally, the corresponding construction suggestions are given for the actual transmission line using grounding module to reduce the resistance. The conclusions of this paper can provide references for the lightning protection of transmission lines and the construction of the grounding grid of towers.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization of UHV Transmission Line Tower Foundation With External Flexible Graphite Composite Grounding Material
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to reduce the natural grounding resistance of the foundation of the UHV, this paper proposes to coat a flexible graphite grounding body outside the concrete to study and analyze the effect of reducing the resistance of the grounding body. Firstly, the single bored pile is equivalently simplified. Then the simulation calculation model of the UHV tower is established in the CDEGS software. The spiral, layered and cage three laying methods are used in different soil resistivity cases. The grounding resistance of the tower foundation is simulated and analyzed, and the effect of different laying methods is analyzed and compared.The research shows that all the three laying methods have significant effect of reducing the resistance. Under the same external conditions, the cage laying method has better resistance reduction effect than the other two. The research content can be applied to the design and construction of the typical UHV transmission line tower foundation, which has engineering application value.

articleTitle: Design of series fault arc waveform generating device
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of tedious testing content and low detection efficiency of arc fault detection device (AFDD), a series fault arc waveform generating device is designed in this paper. Based on the typical waveform database established by the test platform, a signal isolation module with linear analog optical coupler as the core and a power amplifier module with high-power switch tube as the energy-consuming component are designed. The fault arc waveform in the database is restored by the upper computer platform to verify the action characteristics of AFDD. To simulate signal isolation circuit and power amplifier circuit, the co-simulation environment was built by LabVIEW and Multisim. Through the test verification, the device realizes the generation of series fault arc waveform.

articleTitle: TOU Electricity Price Optimization Model for Multi-Customer Considering The PV Ratio Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The implementation of peak-flat-valley time of use (TOU) strategy can reduce the peak-valley difference of purchasing power and improve the reliability of the power grid. The traditional TOU price optimization model only considers the purchasing power of a single customer with the photovoltaic (PV) system. However, for multi-customer, the total purchasing power is related to the PV ratio coefficient, so it is necessary to construct the total purchasing power model based on the PV ratio coefficient. First, this paper establishes the model of energy storage battery (ESB) electricity and calculates the purchasing power for a single customer with a PV system. Next, the model of the multi-customer’s total purchasing power is established by the PV ratio coefficient, and the objective functions of TOU price are constructed with the purpose of peak power shifting. Last, the daily load of residential customer and the output power of PV system are used to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Overvoltage Protection Strategy of Oil-Gas Pipeline Based on Non-metallic Grounding Material
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: High power pulsed power supply is the basis of electromagnetic emission. In this paper, the capacitor voltage limit mode and non-linear resistor voltage limit mode power pulsed power supply are common models. In this paper, two circuit modes based on high temperature superconducting (HTS) pulsed transformers were introduced and the working principle were analyzed respectively. In accordance with the actual parameters of a small experimental superconducting pulsed transformer, the discharging process of two modes was simulated and the characteristics of outputted current pulse were analyzed at different limited primary voltage conditions. The results show that both two circuit modes can effectively limit the primary voltage. However, the overall performance by the capacitor voltage limit mode is better than the use of non-linear resistor voltage limit mode.

articleTitle: Analysis of Temperature Distribution Characteristics of Fuses under Different Arrangement of Ring Network Cabinet Based on Multi-Physical Field Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The high voltage fuse in the ring cabinet works in a high current environment, and its heat dissipation performance is very important for maintaining its normal working performance. For this purpose, the heat dissipation process and differences in different arrangement of fuses under the natural convection condition are studied. First, based on the multi-physical field coupling software COMSOL, we established a three-dimensional simulation model, which is the direct coupling of the flow and temperature field of the fuse in a ring network cabinet under the condition of natural convection, and analyzed the flow and temperature field of the fuse under different layout. The results show that in the same working environment, with the increase of the angle between the fuse and the gravity direction from 0o to 90o, the overall temperature of the fuse will gradually decrease, and the temperature distribution inside the fuse also varies with the change of the angle. The research results are of great significance for analyzing the thermal faults of fuses and optimizing the heat dissipation arrangement of fuses.

articleTitle: Research on EMC of On-line Monitoring Equipment on Shared Tower
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the overall development of the construction of the shared tower, the electromagnetic interference of the communication base station to the surrounding on-line monitoring equipment has become increasingly prominent, but at present there is no standard and construction basis for the protection distance at home and abroad. In this paper, PO-MoM hybrid algorithm is used to calculate the electromagnetic environment of on-line monitoring equipment on shared tower, and the influence of communication antenna on the electromagnetic environment of on-line monitoring equipment on shared tower is obtained. Through the analysis and calculation of tower type, antenna power and different erection modes of antenna, the influence rules of three factors on radiation immunity of on-line monitoring equipment are solved. According to the research results, it is suggested that the protection distance between the communication base station and the on-line monitoring equipment should be set to 15-27m. The results provide a theoretical basis for the further study of the optimal layout of communication antennas on the shared tower and the design of electromagnetic safety engineering of the shared tower, and have certain practical value.

articleTitle: Design of voltage-adaptive CMOD for electromagnetic mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Aim at adaptive CMOD for electromagnetic mechanism, strategy has been designed to widen the input voltage based on existing wide voltage CMOD. CMOD is divided into several submodules according to their function. Submodule can work independently, meanwhile, cooperation among submodules is allowed to output exciting signal for various contactors. Combining current closed-loop control method with intelligent control strategy, software control scheme gives CMOD the ability to fit unknown and uncertain system in order to allow contactors to work on different working condition and load. Further, a voltage-adaptive CMOD for electromagnetic mechanism is designed, simulation and experiment shows that the CMOD can control various contactors work within the expectant voltage range.

articleTitle: Switching Rule Design for DC-DC Converters with Mode-Dependent Average Dwell Time
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The switching rule with mode-dependent average time (MDADT) for DC-DC Buck converter are mainly designed in this paper. The traditional switching rule doesn't consider the use of slow switching. In terms of control theory, the slow switching mode can also make the systems stable because the switching signal combined with MDADT keep the system stable asymptotically. Moreover, the chattering problem of sliding mode can be suppressed. Performance of the system is evaluated according to a series of simulations.

articleTitle: Challenges and Solutions in Current Power Wireless Private Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Power wireless private network is well developed in China in recent years. It makes the information exchange between devices easily and it is easy to deploy comparing with the wired communication. It is also the basics of the energy Internet of things. Although the power wireless private is the imitation of the public cellular network, there are still a lot of special challenges in the power private network. In this paper, we discuss some of the typical challenges and proposed our solutions. For the interference management in power wireless private in LTE 230 system, we propose the multi-channel bidirectional selection to overcome the potential interferer which cannot be discovered according to the channel reciprocity.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of AC Contactor Based on Virtual Prototyping Design Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper established a virtual prototyping design platform for AC contactor. A dual E-type AC contactor was used as the research object. The dynamic characteristics and thermal characteristics of the contactor were simulated based on the virtual design platform. The accuracy and feasibility of the platform simulation model were verified by experiments. On the basis of this platform, the influences of different sub-magnet ring structure parameters and core structure parameters on electromagnetic attraction and temperature rise of the AC contactor are analyzed. This paper provides an efficient and feasible method for the development and design of AC contactor, and provides a reference for the structural design of the AC contactor.

articleTitle: Simulation of Lightning Protection Effect for Overhead Ground Wire of 10kV Distribution Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Due to the low insulation level of 10kV overhead distribution lines, ground wires were seldom used in the lightning protection design of distribution lines in China. In this paper, the influence of different types of towers, types of insulators, impulse grounding resistance of tower, and lightning position on the protective effect of overhead ground lines are analyzed by the numerical simulation of the 10kV distribution line. The results show that there are two important measures to improve the lightning withstand level of the distribution lines: improving the insulation level and reducing the impact grounding resistance of the line tower. The type of pole tower has a close relation to the lightning withstand level of the line, as well as the impact grounding resistance of the tower. Lightning location on the line has less effect on lightning withstand level.

articleTitle: Velocity characteristics of vacuum arc cathode spot under medium frequency
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The DC circuit breaker is used to realize fault isolation and clearing of the DC system, and is an essential core equipment for the DC distribution network. The principle of the mechanical DC circuit breaker is to generate the medium frequency oscillating current by LC and reversely inject into the main circuit to form a current zero crossing point, and then complete the breaking by the AC circuit breaker. In this paper, the velocity of vacuum arc cathode spot group at medium frequency current is studied by constructing a detachable vacuum interrupter simulation device. The study found that the splitting of the cathode spot group has two modes, corresponding to two different velocity of motion. The velocity of the cathode spot group increases with the increase of the frequency and current amplitude. Compared with the reported power frequency arc cathode spots velocity, the cathode spot group velocity under the medium frequency is much larger which can faster than 1000 m/s.

articleTitle: A second-order screening method for Preventive regions
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The screening and ranking of expected accidents is often the first step in the safety and stability prevention and control strategy. The analysis time of the screening process is long and the calculation is large. In this paper, a second-order screening method for anticipatory accidents is proposed. in essence, all the expected events are screened quickly and the target set is obtained. then, according to the characteristics of each event in the target set, some events are selected for margin analysis. The proposed method can quickly obtain the prevention area. The simulation results show that the method is correct.

articleTitle: IGBSG 2019 Keynotes
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the keynote presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Torque Control for Three-phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, the speed feedback based on sliding mode controller was proposed for the three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor. The aim of the controller is to control speed better and reduce the electromagnetic torque ripple based on sliding mode controller. Firstly, the current error of the motor was set as the objective function. Then a feedforward control scheme was designed to achieve current decoupling. Secondly, the Lyapunov's second method was used to verify the stability of the system, with the decoupled control law. Finally, the validity of the proposed method was confirmed.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Carbon Fiber Eight-split Wires Hook for UHV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The heavy hook may cause the problem of high labor intensity, high risk coefficient and low work efficiency during replacing the insulator string of Ultra high voltage (UHV) transmission lines. By using the finite element method, the mechanical properties of the carbon fiber wires hook was analyzed through structural optimization and the process design of carbon fiber layering. The successful development of carbon fiber eight-split wires hooks lays a foundation for the application of carbon fiber composites in UHV transmission lines live working.

articleTitle: Optimum Design of Wireless Charging System Based on Magnetic Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient routing inspection endurance of UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) in power grid, this paper proposed a wireless charging scheme for UAV based on resonance magnetic coupling, analyzed the technical feasibility of high-voltage energy acquisition with double CT structure which is based on the experimental platform of high-voltage energy acquisition module, studied the influence between coil turn and the parameters of CT energy acquisition, designed the power supply circuit of the energy acquisition module which includes peripheral Circuit parameter and battery management Flow. This paper achieved the optimum design of coil parameters for wireless charging unit. The research could improve the endurance of UAV for transmission line inspection and provide support of reliable line inspection which made influence of the power gird safe and stable operation.

articleTitle: Experiment and Simulation of Steel Core Crimping and Breaking of Large Cross-Section Conductor
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The Large-section wire transmission will be widely used as an independent development of UHV transmission technology. However, after the crimping of the transmission line is completed, the internal defects of the crimping tube are not easily found. Internal defects such as internal steel core surface scratches and broken strands severely reduce the current carrying capacity and mechanical strength of the transmission line. In this paper, the JL/G1A-400/35 large-section conductor steel core was crimped and broken. It was found that the steel core after crimping was easily broken, and the strength of the steel core after crimping was smaller than the theoretical calculation. This shows that the steel core has greater damage during the crimping process and reduces the tensile strength. In this paper, the pull-off simulation calculations of the two kinds of steel core damage types after crimping are carried out, and the influence of the steel core damage on the maximum breaking force during the crimping process is obtained, which can provide reference for the optimization of the crimping process.

articleTitle: Research on Efficiency Improvement Strategy of A New Type of Photovoltaic Power Generation Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the increasingly prominent environmental problems, the proportion of photovoltaic in distributed power supply is increasing. In this paper, a new tracking method of solar maximum power point is proposed, which can keep the system in the position of maximum power point, and build on Matlab/Simulink simulation model to proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Voltage Optimization Control of Asynchronous Wind Turbine Based on Magnetic Energy Regeneration Switch
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the voltage of the grid-connected node of the asynchronous wind turbine fluctuates with the load change, a three-phase magnetic energy regeneration switch (MERS) topology and the voltage optimization adjustment method of the grid-connected node are proposed. The paper analyzes the system structure and the working principle of MERS reactive power regulation; Secondly, in order to enhance the tracking effect of MERS, reduce the disturbance amount and improve the adaptability to asynchronous wind turbines, the fuzzy parameter optimization control strategy is adopted to achieve accurate dynamic reactive power compensation and improve the dynamic response speed of the system; The simulation proves that the topology and control method can realize the fast and precise adjustment of the reactive power of the grid-connected nodes and maintain the node voltage stability.

articleTitle: Coordination Dispatch for the Wind Farm-Combined Heat and Power-Electric Boiler Considering Real-Time Pricing
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Large-scale wind power integration in the three-north area makes the wind curtailment seriously in winter, the coordinated optimal dispatching model of wind power, cogeneration and electric boiler based on real-time pricing is proposed to solve the problem. In this model, the real-time pricing incentive mechanism is introduced into the joint system to guide the market behavior between the load side and the generation side, realizing the dynamic transfer of power on the load side. The model installs the electric boiler decoupling "heat-set" constraint on the load side, the wind power accommodation space of the system is enlarged by the dual wind power dissipation function of the electric boiler under the power market environment, the sum of the user-side electricity purchase fee and the penalty fee of wind curtailment is minimized. After simulating and analyzing the power grid in an area of the three-north area, the results show that it realizes the dynamic load transfer and thermal electrolysis coupling in the target optimization solution process and maximizes the absorption of wind energy, and the difference in load peak and valley has also been significantly improved.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Lifetime Models in IGBT Power Modules
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the high speed extend of the wind turbine generation, lifetime estimation model for the core components in wind turbine converter is important for design and maintenance. Several lifetime models were proposed, which consider the long term effect. However, the effects of a huge amount of small stress cycles are usually ignored in most models. Lifetime models with and without considering the effects of small stress cycles are compared, and errors between different models are studied. The results show that some models have a huge error when the minor stress cycles are not considered. The reliability analysis is important for converter design to achieve an expected lifetime and reduce the failure rate.

articleTitle: Pareto Optimal Distribution Network Grid Planning Based on Safety Efficacy Cost Model
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, the safety, efficiency and cost (SEC) concept of asset life management are introduced into distribution network planning, and a multi-objective programming model considering safety, efficiency and cost is established. Subsequently, Strength Pareto Evolutionary Algorithm (SPEA2) is employed to seek the Pareto optimal frontier. At the same time, the original grid and the corridor information of distribution network are considered in the solving process. Afterwards, the planning program set of SEC of the grid structure is obtained, and the comprehensive benefit index is used to sort the Pareto non-inferior solution set in the second-level optimization decision-making so as to solve and select the optimal decision-making scheme. The simulation results based on the IEEE 33-bus system demonstrate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Multiphase Interleaved Equalization Circuit Based on Graph Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries play an important role in large-scale energy storage systems. However, the power inconsistency of the battery packs restricts the developments of modern technologies in energy storage area. The motivation of the present study is to serve the growing needs of the energy balance for lithium-ion battery packs. The present study proposes a flexible multiphase interleaved converter for the energy equalization of a lithium battery pack with series configuration. Moreover, the graph theory is applied to the analysis of equalization circuits. It is intended to establish a unified standard for the comparison. The parameter of average efficiency is considered as an important indicator to evaluate the characteristics of the equilibrium system. The proposed method is verified by constructing a lithium-ion battery pack with the equalization circuit. It is observed that the proposed multiphase interleaved converter has flexible characteristics, while it has low energy loss compared with the conventional methods. It is found that the proposed method simplifies the complex equalization circuits into graphs and facilitates the comparison of the average efficiency of the system. It is concluded that this method is a feasible and powerful method for evaluating the battery equalization circuit. This approach can be applied for solving complex problems in other engineering applications.

articleTitle: Design of battery fast charging method combined with improved interleaved topology
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this study, a fast-charging strategy based on improved interleaved buck converter is proposed. Compared with traditional interleaved buck converter, the improved interleaved buck converter can guarantee small switching losses and high efficiency. Meanwhile, a fast-charging strategy is developed in this study. Using a constant current method, which can achieve the effect of fast charging. Finally, the simulation is carried out by SIMPLIS.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Extraction with Improved Terminal Load Voltage for Standalone Wind Generating Systems Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Global warming, high carbon emission and increasing energy demand requires high penetration of green and clean renewable energy resources in existing microgrid systems. Remote areas need reliable solutions for fulfilling electricity needs for their daily life activities across the globe. Wind energy utilization is increasing worldwide with wind-battery-load topology as a cost-effective solution for remote area electrification and standalone hybrid microgrid clusters. Intelligent control of voltage source inverter (VSI) ensures high power quality with efficient voltage and frequency profile for sensitive and critical loads. While maximum wind power extraction provides reliable solution with battery energy storage system (BESS). In this paper, finite control set model predictive voltage control (FCS-MPVC) is proposed for wind-battery based standalone microgrid to regulate load voltage and frequency. Control hierarchy consists of dc-dc converters and VSI. Wind maximum power is extracted by using dc-dc boost converter and DC bus voltage is stabilized by using bidirectional battery converter. MPC strategy is used for primary control, which includes power droop control, three phase reference generator, and inner control loop. Fluctuating wind under variable ac load conditions are simulated. Results show the effectiveness of MPC as compared to PI controller in obtaining load voltage with THD less than 1%.

articleTitle: The design and application of distribution management system to Port Moresby grid
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper is based on a practical distribution management system (DMS) project which aims to enhance power supply reliability and system capacity for Port Moresby (POM) future load growth. To begin with, the general characteristics and the basic merits of DMS are introduced. After the theoretical analysis, the background of practical project is illustrated. Besides that, the design of the overview architecture and system configuration is given as well. Moreover, the operating principles of the master station in DMS are analyzed. At last, the conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Optimization Research on Grounding Resistance of Power Transmission Line Tower Foundation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Improving the current divergence characteristics of the tower foundation can effectively reduce the tower grounding resistance and reduce the cost of secondary artificial grounding. At present, it is necessary to further study the grounding of the tower foundation. In this paper, the finite element simulation software COMSOL is used to build single-pile concrete foundation simulation models and multi-pile concrete foundation simulation models. Five kinds of tower foundation external resistance reduction methods based on flexible planar composite grounding materials are proposed, such as full-laying, lower-half-laying, upper-laying, middle-laying and lower-laying. The effects of external radius, tower depth and groundwater layer position on grounding resistance are investigated. The effects of the aquifer on the current density distribution are compared. The effects of aquifers on current density distribution and the effects of three multi-pile resistance reduction schemes on ground potential and current density are compared. The simulation results show that increasing the external radius and tower depth is beneficial to improve the efficiency of reducing the resistance. From the big to the small, the efficiency of resistance reduction by external application of pile-by-pile is full application, lower half application, lower, middle and upper. The aquifer reduces the grounding resistance of the foundation, and when the aquifer is closer to the surface, the effect of reducing the resistance is more obvious. When the multi-pile foundation with higher voltage level adopts external application to reduce resistance, the efficiency of external application of ring wrap is higher than that of pile-by-pile application. The conclusions of this paper can provide reference for the actual transmission line design and lightning protection grounding construction.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Four-Wire Harmonic Analysis based on ZBUS Power-Flow Solutions for Radial Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, a three-phase four-wire harmonic power flow analysis technique using a direct ZBUS method for distribution networks (DNs) is proposed. In this method, component models for three-phase four-wire DNs are developed considering neutral wires and grounding. In addition, harmonic loads are represented as equivalent injection currents. Finally, the outcome of a series of tests is used to verify the solutions of three-phase four-wire harmonic power flow problems.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Algorithm of Hourly Diffuse Radiation Model
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, the hourly solar radiation data of 2011 in Beijing and Wuhan are collected in order to predict the diffuse irradiation ratio more accurately. First, the local solar energy resources are evaluated according to three indicators. Then the applicability of the Erbs model has been tested. Finally, a new model based on sky clearness index and solar altitude angle are used to modify the Erbs model. The results show that the total radiation in Beijing is 5189.36 MJ/m2 and it is single peak. The stability is 0.32. Direct ratio is 0.5. And the total radiation in Wuhan is 4261.93 MJ/m2 and it is double peak. The stability is 0.34. Direct ratio is 0.39. The shape of the data distribution of the hourly diffuse irradiation ratio is similar to that of the Erbs model. However, the measured values are not only related to the clearness index, but also to the solar altitude angle. The revised models improve the prediction accuracy. It provides an important basis for the design of photovoltaic system.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Current Transformer’s Tail Current Based on Waveform Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: After the circuit breaker trips, the secondary side of the current transformer (CT) will produce a tail current, which is affected by factors such as the initial amplitude of the tail current and the time constant of the CT secondary side. The tail current may cause malfunction of the failure protection. At present, the identification method of waveform zero-crossing detection is often used to distinguish fault current and tail current, but in some cases, the method will also be invalid, and need a longer identification time. In order to reduce the speed and improve the reliability of tail current recognition, this paper, based on waveform characteristics, proposes an identification method of current transformer's tail current. The generation mechanism of tail current is analyzed, and an identification method of tail current based on decrement-concavity characteristics is proposed for the difference of waveform between tail current and fault current in time domain. The reliability of the proposed method is verified by the simulation of PSCAD.

articleTitle: Shielding Failure Trip-out Rate algorithm based on Improved EGM transmission line
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to take into the accuracy and engineering practicability of the transmission line shielding failure trip-out rate, the three factors of terrain inclination, high-altitude wind speed and lightning leader angle are introduced, and the method of improving the traditional electrical geometry model is proposed. Based on the traditional electrical geometry model, the coordinate system of the line tower on the top of the mountain, the hillside, and the line climbing erection condition is constructed based on the analysis of the geometrical positional changes of the spatial position between the conductor and the ground wind and the ground plane. Through the coordinate rotation, the equations of maximum hitting distance, exposed arc and shielding failure trip-out rate under the influence of multi-parameters are deduced. The algorithm for solving the multi-parameter shielding failure trip-out rate is proposed. The proposed algorithm is verified by taking the US 345kV transmission line as an example. The results show that the error is reduced by 56.15% compared with the traditional algorithm.

Author Keywords: angle of incidence of lightning leader

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Electromagnetic Transient Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Aiming at the current situation that the existing electromagnetic transient calculation software has high requirement for experience and can not meet the timeliness requirement of power grid fault analysis, an Electromagnetic Transient Calculation Platform (abbreviated as the ETCP) is constructed through the secondary development of ATP-EMTP software. Based on the ETCP, several over-voltage calculation and risk assessment work, simulation analysis of on-load voltage regulation and capacitance regulation of distribution transformer, feasibility analysis of series reactor of main transformer neutral point, simulation calculation of low frequency oscillation of the PT have been carried out, which verifies the effectiveness and practicability of the ETCP.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Method of Open-loop Scheme of Electromagnetic Loop Network Based on Comprehensive Weight
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: From a mathematical point of view, the evaluation of the open loop scheme of electromagnetic loop network is a multi-objective optimization problem. This paper combines subjective and objective weighting methods and takes fully into account the evaluation elements of electromagnetic loop network open-loop, and proposes an evaluation method based on comprehensive weighting for open-loop schemes of electromagnetic loop network. Firstly, the opening principle and mechanism of electromagnetic loop network are analyzed. On this basis, the comprehensive evaluation index system of the open loop scheme of the electromagnetic loop network is established by taking into account safety and stability of the system, current limiting effect and economic operation and so on. Then, in order to calculate the subjective and objective weight coefficient by using the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and the coefficient of variation method and through the comprehensive evaluation calculation to obtain a comprehensive index to evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of the open-loop scheme. The rationality and validity of the method presented in this paper are verified through the example analysis of an actual grid in one province and the simulation analysis by using PSASP.

articleTitle: A High-Performance AWG-based Optical WDM Two-SubRing Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In this paper, we design a two-subring network based on a passive 2*2 AWG device and also a novel distributed medium access control (MAC) scheme to achieve low-cost, scalable, and high-performance systems. We have previously proposed a high-performance design of an experimental testbed system for an optical packet-switched (OPS) metro ring network, called HOPSMAN. Our proposed system uses only a tunable transmitter and a fixed-tuned receiver to achieve exceptional high performance, which is shown to be approximately 1.5 times better than that of HOPSMAN in which each node is constructed by a tunable transmitter and a high-cost tunable receiver. Extensive simulation and analytic results demonstrate that the proposed MAC scheme achieves exceptional system performance under a wide range of traffic loads and various system parameters.

articleTitle: Design of Traffic-Signal Condition Detection System Based on Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of slow information feedback, long monitoring cycle and high cost of traditional traffic signal detection method, a new intelligent traffic signal monitoring system based on sensor and upper computer development system is designed. The system uses the light sensor with double monitoring circuit of current sensor, and clever applies the hall element for current measurements, in the case of basic does not change the original circuit monitoring to the traffic lights work of real-time data to avoid affecting the original circuit of traffic lights, meantime, it have improved the reliability and stability of the monitoring.

articleTitle: Equal-potential Entering Path and Arc Energy Calculation Method for Live Working on ±800kV DC Transmission Line Based on FEM
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In order to ensure the reliability of safety protection during equal-potential transfer, it is necessary to study the potential transfer current and arc energy of the ± 800kV UHVDC transmission line. For the purpose, an arc energy circuit model and a calculation model were built. FEM was used to calculate the relationship between human potential, different transfer distances, suspension potential gap capacitance and potential transfer arc energy under three equal-potential entering Paths. According to the calculation, when entering the pole conductor from below, the potential will be the lowest, and the potential transfer arc energy is the maximum among the three ways. When entering the pole conductor from above, it will have the highest potential and the minimum energy of potential transfer arc. The calculation method and results can be used as a reference for the selection of equal-potential entering path and the design of safety protective equipment of the ± 800kV HVDC transmission line during live working programs.

articleTitle: Modeling and Research on Grounding Impedance of Large Ground Grid under Complex Geological Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: With the rapid growth of power load demand, many large-capacity UHVDC and AC transmission lines are put into operation, so the grounding fault current problem of substation is becoming more and more serious. Grounding grid is a common measure to solve the grounding fault of power plant and station, but its grounding impedance and soil resistivity are facing the problem of precision measurement. In this paper, a three-dimensional simulation model is built by finite element software. The potential distribution and impedance of the ground network model are calculated and analyzed by applying 10A and 100V/50Hz current sources to seven current poles located at different diagonal positions of the ground network. The results show that the model can effectively analyze the influence of grounding grid and soil module resistivity on surface potential.

articleTitle: Static Voltage Stability Analysis under Different Accident Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The study of static voltage stability is actually based on asymptotic stability, which is affected by the operation state of the power grid. In this paper, the voltage stability margin index is deduced, and the stability margin of the existing power grid under different actual working conditions is analyzed based on the proposed index. the leading factors and the worst system conditions are determined by practical experience. The correctness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation analysis of the actual provincial power grid.

articleTitle: Fault location of multistage feeders in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: To enhance the fault location precision of multistage feeders in distribution network, a new section location method is proposed. In this paper, the fault characteristics of transient zero-sequence current transient components are analyzed, and the amplitude characteristics of zero-sequence current in the upstream and downstream nodes of the fault point are determined by using the mathematical relationship. The Hausdorff distance algorithm is introduced to construct a comprehensive criterion combining section distance and correlation coefficient. Further, the fault section can be effectively distinguished by comparing the criterion with the set threshold. The Matlab simulation demonstrates that the proposed method can accurately locate the fault section.

articleTitle: Fault Identification and Reclosing Technology for DG Access to Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The scale of the new energy power supply brings many new problems and challenges to the traditional protection based on the local quantity and automatic reclosing technology. Aiming at this question, firstly, this paper analyzes the influence of new energy units' access to power distribution automatic reclosing device. Based on this, an automatic reclosing control method based on multi-source regional information is proposed. Firstly, the fault tripping matrix is obtained through the network topology association matrix and fault information matrix, and then the strategy of acceleration trip can be accelerated after determination. Finally, the superposition matrix is overlapped according to the latter acceleration. At last, through digital simulation, the correctness of principle of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: A Survey of Constant Switching Frequency Model Predictive Control in Power Electronics
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The traditional model predictive control uses only one switching vector for every per sampling cycle, which causes the variable switching frequency in rolling optimization and makes the filter difficult to design. In this paper, the problem of rolling optimization is analyzed in detail by the variable switching frequency and cost function. Some optimization methods are put forward according to the performance requirements, which provides a new idea for the development of model predictive control(MPC).

articleTitle: A Method of Mechanical Fault Feature Extraction for High-Voltage Circuit Breaker Via CEEMDAN and Weighted Time-Frequency Entropy
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The critical step in the mechanical fault diagnoses of a high-voltage circuit breaker (HVCB) is the extraction of mechanical state characteristics. The effectiveness of these characteristics is related to the accuracy of the corresponding diagnostic results. A novel method for the mechanical fault feature extraction of a HVCB via complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) and weighted time-frequency entropy is proposed in this study. First, the time-frequency decomposition of vibration signals is performed by the CEEMDAN and the Hilbert transform to obtain the instantaneous frequency of intrinsic mode function (IMF) components. Then, the IMFs are reconstructed via a bandpass filter to gain a signal component of the specified frequency band. In addition, the weighted time-frequency entropy feature is extracted from the energy matrix. Through the verification of multiple groups of classifiers, the diagnostic results have a higher accuracy, which indicates that the proposed method can effectively characterize different mechanical faults.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Current I Segment Protection of Smart Converter Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In the distributed power access distribution network, the short circuit current dynamically changes with the difference of accessed capacity and position, resulting in insufficient sensitivity or even refusal of the traditional three-stage current protection based on the maximum operation mode setting. Adaptive current protection in the distribution network needs to be studied. Based on the analysis of the influence of distributed power supply distribution network on current protection, the composite fault network is constructed when the system occurs in the upstream, downstream or adjacent feeders of the distributed power supply. Further, the positive sequence voltage and the positive sequence current at the time of the fault are used to calculate the current at the end of the line in real time, and based on this, the current value of the over-current protection I segment is set. Finally, it is verified that the protection method can set the current value and improve the protection performance based on the PSCAD simulation.

articleTitle: Design of Power Electronic Device Controller with Multi-Time Scale Control and Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The Digital Signal Processor (DSP) has a mature and extensive application in the control and protection of medium and low voltage and medium and small power electronic devices, but there are some shortcomings in the control and protection application of high voltage and high power electronic devices, such as single time scale and difficulty in increasing the controllable semaphore. Aiming at high voltage and high power electronic devices, this paper designs a multi-time scale controller based on DSP, FPGA, and CPLD. Among them, DSP completes millisecond algorithm operation and logic control; FPGA performs microsecond AD sampling and PWM signal generation; CPLD realizes signal level PWM signal detection and fault blocking. The main control board and peripheral plug-in board are separated on the controller hardware to improve the expansibility of the controller. Finally, the feasibility of the controller design is proved by experiments.

articleTitle: Transmission line electrification spanning construction technology
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In the process of spanning the transmission line across the frame, the existing spanning spanning construction technology can not fully meet the requirements of high efficiency, safety and reliability and wide application range. Aiming at this problem, based on the thinking of the double-sided rotary docking of the bridge, this paper proposes an uninterrupted power spanning construction technology based on the double-sided rotating arm type spanning frame. Firstly, the construction technology of double-sided flat-rotating bridge without power-off is briefly introduced. Then, the construction tools and construction steps are studied. Finally, based on the deep consideration of the construction steps, two construction technical difficulties of double-sided rotating arm docking and cross-frame size determination were proposed and solved.

articleTitle: The doubly-fed wind power generation system based on smart grid lab
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper introduces the doubly-fed induction generator wind turbine running system based on the smart grid laboratory of the Three Gorges University .This system can simulate actual state of the wind, and investigate the operation condition of the generator of different wind strength. It can also control the output voltage and frequency and determine the best working point in different wind conditions.

articleTitle: Protection of Shared Tower for Aeronautical Radio Navigation Station
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: According to GB 6364-2013 "Aeronautical Radio Navigation Station Electromagnetic Environment Requirements", China lacks the design and construction basis for the protection spacing of shared iron towers. To this end, starting from the interference protection rate of the aeronautical radio navigation station, by establishing a mathematical solution model for the protection distance between the shared tower and the aeronautical radionavigation station, the installation method of the shared tower, the type of the tower and the base number of the tower under a certain line length are carried out. The analysis and the law of the interference protection rate under the influence of these three variables are changed with the distance between the two systems. The results show that the main factors affecting the aeronautical radio range finder station are the installation mode of the shared tower and the number of towers under a certain line length. According to the research results, it is reasonable to set the protection distance between the shared tower and the aeronautical radio navigation station to be within the range of 500m~700m.

articleTitle: A New method for Windage yaw Detection of Composite Insulator Based on Video Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In recent years, windage yaw flashover accidents on transmission lines occurred frequently, which posed a serious threat to safety and reliability of a power grid. Existing methods for windage yaw detection of transmission lines generally use sensors to collect swing angle of insulator strings, but the reliability is not high enough. This paper proposes a windage yaw detection technology of composite insulator based on video analysis. Tracker software was used to analyze the video of windage yaw of composite insulators. And the amplitude, frequency and swing angle of windage yaw of composite insulators can be obtained through analysis. The results showed that the proposed method can detect the windage yaw of composite insulators in millimeter scale, which has practical significance on power grid disaster prevention and mitigation caused by windage yaw.

articleTitle: The Improvement of Quine-McCluskey Method Using Set Covering Problem for Safety Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: When designing complex safety systems which consist of large scale logical circuits, the basic requirement is to minimise the number of elements that will implement the given logical functions. This will increase the reliability, and thus potentially the security of the devices. For logical functions with a number of variables of no more than 4, Karnaugh maps are preferred. However, in practice, we encounter much more complex functions, either directly applying Boolean algebra laws or using the Quine-McCluskey method, which is based on their systematic use. However, because this method does not provide a minimal form of logical function, and as a result, there may be redundant expressions, we will show that the additional phase of minimisation means solving the problem of covering all inputs by the obtained output expressions. For the purpose of clear representation and implementation process of post-processing method, the genetic algorithms and simulated annealing were implemented on OR-Library benchmarks.

articleTitle: Simulation of Frequency Characteristics of Longitudinal Magnetic Field Distribution of Cup-Shaped Contacts in Vacuum Interrupter
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: DC circuit breakers are used to achieve fault isolation and clearing of DC systems. It is an essential core equipment for DC network construction. The contact of the vacuum interrupter in the mechanical DC circuit breaker has different magnetic field distribution under different frequency currents. It affects the breaking ability of the breaker at different current frequencies. The cup contact is a commonly used contact in a vacuum interrupter. In this paper, the transient three-dimensional magnetic field distribution of the cup contact at 50~10000Hz current frequency is simulated. The variation of the longitudinal magnetic field distribution along the center of the open center plane with frequency is analyzed. It has been found that the magnetic field lag time of the cup-shaped contact at medium frequency current is large, and it cannot keep up with the change of current. It is too late to establish a longitudinal magnetic field during the arcing process. Therefore, it is similar to the flat contact in the process of breaking the vacuum arc, so that the structure of the cup contact does not play its due role. In order to reduce the magnetic field lag time of the cup contact at medium frequency current, it is necessary to redesign its geometry.

articleTitle: Two-stage Energy Storage Power Converter with Coordinated Control
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper proposes a coordinated control strategy for two-stage power converter based on power feedforward. By introducing a power feedforward link in the grid-connected current command, the information of the DC/AC converter output change is reflected in the DC/DC converter control in time. The energy relationship of two-stage converter and the effect of power feedforward on system performance are analyzed. Experiments verify that the proposed control strategy can improve the response of the system to changes in output power and suppress the fluctuation of DC bus capacitor voltage.

articleTitle: Digital Image Transmission with Polar Codes and Median Filtering
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
