abstract: In digital images, different bits can carry different degrees of importance. Therefore, unequal error protection (UEP) is quite often incorporated into the transmission of digital images. The so-called "protection' is achieved via error control coding (ECC), for which the most investigated ECC class in recent years - namely, polar codes - are adopted in this work. One key issue with polar codes is code construction - determination of frozen bit-channels and information bit-channels. Moreover, for UEP, the order of the information bit-channels according to which the various bits in image pixels are to be placed needs to be determined. One specific ordering scheme is proposed in this paper and compared to an existing method. One phenomenon observed in polar decoding is that whenever there occurs an erroneously decoded bit, the succeeding bits are also likely to become erroneously decoded. In terms of visual quality, this problem translates into continous line-segments of obviously wrong lightness. To counter this problem, the technique of median filtering combined with pixel-interleaving is adopted in this work. It turns out that our scheme produces good results, in terms of the PSNR (peak signal-to-noise ratio) and the visua quality of the recovered images.

articleTitle: Selection and protection of earthing transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper introduces the application trend of small resistance grounding system, explains the selection and protection methods of earthing transformer, and demonstrates the calculation process with an engineering example.

articleTitle: Research on Power-off Replacement Calculation of Transmission Line Insulators Based on Life Cycle Cost
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Transmission line engineering is a strategic asset with heavy assets and long life. Its normal operation depended on maintenance and maintenance. The initial design of traditional transmission lines mainly considers the initial construction cost and operation cost, and the line maintenance was rarely considered, not even considered. This paper proposes a cost calculation method for replacing the insulator string of power transmission line based on the life cycle cost, and considers the calculation method of the power failure replacement cost of the transmission line year by year in the whole life cycle. In the calculation of the line insulator failure rate, the improved gray GM (1,1) model is used to predict the line insulator failure rate in the medium and long term, which makes the line maintenance cost calculation more accurate. According to the actual engineering examples, it is verified that the convenience of inspection and maintenance improves the economic efficiency of the overall transmission line.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement of Bridge Differential Protection Behavior of Smart Converter Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: For the AC-DC hybrid system in converter transformer no-load closing, AC system grounding fault operation conditions, the AC system will produce a large number of zero sequence current. The zero-sequence current cannot be transmitted through Y/Δ converter transformer, a large number of non-periodic components caused TA asymmetry saturation. The measurement results have a larger error lead to bridge differential protection misoperate. This paper simulates the current transformer saturation and analyzes the incorrect operation of bridge difference protection. And it introduces the zero-sequence current of AC system, this method balances the difference current, which caused by TA asymmetry saturation. The improved bridge differential protection criterion is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Optimization of Dispatching a Charging Station with Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The emergence of electric vehicles (EVs) promises to yield multiple benefits to both power and transportation industry sectors, but it is also likely to affect the distribution network reliability by consuming massive energy. However, the charging and discharging of EVs at EV charging station (EVCS) must be controlled and scheduled in order to reduce the peak load. This paper considers the problem of ordered charging and discharging of EVs at a single charging station. A scheduling optimization strategy for EVCS is proposed, taking the maximum revenue of EVCS as the optimization objective, and considering the constraints of power demand of owners, charging time, discharging time, and capacity of distribution network. In order to overcome the shortcomings of the fixed time-of-use (TOU) price strategy, the dynamic TOU price is solved by particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, which regards the price as a variable at each time period of EVCS dispatching cycle. The simulation results show that the proposed method can significantly augment the revenue of EVCS, reduce peak load, fill valley, and meet the needs of EV owners to the greatest extent.

articleTitle: Temperature Rise Analysis of the Insulating Blanket in the Live Working of 10 kV Distribution Line
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Live working is an important method to improve the reliability of the power distribution network. In order to protect the safety of worker, the insulating protective tool, such as insulating blanket, is used to wrap the high voltage conductor. The temperature rise characteristics of the insulating blanket have been researched in this paper. The thermal-fluid coupled calculation is used to simulate the temperature rise and heat dissipation process of the insulating blanket in the live working of 10 kV distribution line (type is JL/G1A-70/10). The simplify method of the steel core aluminum stranded conductor is put forward. The effect of length and thinness of the insulating blanket, wind speed, and sunshine intensity on the temperature distribution of the insulating blanket is analyzed. Results show that the temperature distribution is basically the same when the stranded conductor is simplified to a single conductor. The maximum temperature difference between inside and outside of the insulating blanket is about 22 K under the natural convection environment. The effect of thickness on temperature rise is greater than that of length for this insulating blanket. The wind speed and sunshine have a large influence on the temperature distribution of the insulating blanket.

articleTitle: A Novel Scheme of Single-Line-Grounded-Fault Detection and Its Practical Implementation for Non-Effective Grounded System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Manual isolation of transmission line so far has been a common way for single-line-grounded-fault detection in non-effective grounded system. However, in practice, due to factors such as insufficient selection criterion and poor function, the line selection accuracy is not high and the application effect is not good as expected. This paper proposes a novel scheme of grounded-fault line detection which can selectively and sequentially perform line trip by dynamic weighed line selection and automatic sequential isolation. The proposed method can reduce manual participation, alleviate operating personnel work pressure and consequently improve the efficiency of fault isolation. Besides, the proposed scheme can shorten the duration of single-phase grounded fault and effectively reduce the hidden human safety risk.

articleTitle: Graphical Modeling and simulation of the Power Station Switch System
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The circuit breaker and the relevant disconnecting switches of power station have different varieties in large quantity. Due to the different specific operation processes of the switches, the switch system simulation is quite complex. Adopting the graphical and modular modeling approach, classify the switch system into various sub-modules to set up the universal models, and put forward the new methods of the logical interlock judgment for the switch motion process based on the node merging topology analysis algorithm, improving the generality of the simulating model of the electrical switch system. The modeling method provide an effective way for the large-scale customization of the power station simulation system.

articleTitle: Research of Probabilistic Modeling Method Aimed at Uncertain Factors
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: the rapid development of distributed generation technology has brought a large number of uncertain factors to the power grid. The research of probability distribution model of these uncertain factors has great significance to the planning and operation of the power grid. Taking the uncertainty problem in wind farm as an example, a non-parametric kernel density estimation method for wind power probability density model based on fuzzy ordinal optimization is proposed in this paper. Based on the historical data sample of wind power operation, a non-parametric kernel density estimation model of wind power probability density is established in the method, and then a multi-objective optimization model of bandwidth selection is also constructed. Finally, the fuzzy ordinal optimization is used to solve the bandwidth optimization model. The result of practical examples show that the method is completely driven by the sample data and has no need to perform a priori subjective assumption on the probability density model as in the traditional way. Therefore, it has higher modeling accuracy and stronger applicable ability.

articleTitle: Enhanced Successive Cancellation for Decoding of Polar Codes with Very Low Latency through Multiple Parity Checks
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The class of polar codes is the latest development in the field of error correcting for digital communications. One problem with polar codes is that they suffer long latency in the decoding due to the successive-cancellation (SC) nature in the decision process. Various methods have been proposed to ease this problem. In particular, a scheme called simplified successive cancellation (SSC) was proposed shortly after the introduction of polar codes. Then, an improved version of SSC, which is referred to as fast simplified successive cancellation (FSSC) in this paper, was proposed. In this paper, some ideas in SSC and FSSC are further extended to enable even faster decoding of polar codes. We refer to this this newly proposed scheme as enhanced fast simplified successive cancellation (EFSSC). Its computation latency is analyzed and compared to SC, SSC, and FSSC. Moreover, its BLER (block error rate) performance is also presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of a New Hybrid Sturdy MASH-11 Delta-Sigma Modulator
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper presents a new two-stage hybrid sturdy MASH (SMASH) delta-sigma modulator (DSM) called HSMASH-11 DSM that can theoretically regains the 3 dB signal-to-noise and distortion ratio (SNDR) loss that a SMASH-11 DSM loses to a conventional MASH-11 DSM. In addition, the HSMASH-11 DSM still retains the insensitivity to the opamp gain that a SMASH-11 possesses. The HSMASH-11 DSM employs both inverting and non-inverting integrators in its structure. Mathematical and simulation results validate the efficiency of the proposed HSMASH-11 DSM.

articleTitle: The Vibration Prediction of Hydro-generating Units based Grey Relational Analysis and Fuzzy Support Vector Regression
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The vibration prediction is very important to ensure safe and steady operation of hydropower stations due to the fact that most faults of hydro-generating units (HGU) are reflected in the form of vibration. In this paper, a predicting approach based on grey relational analysis (GRA) and fuzzy support vector regression (FSVR) is applied to the vibration prediction of the HGU. Firstly, the correlation grade between the primary predicting factors and the vibration are measured by GRA, based on which the predicting factors are determined. Subsequently, the predicting model is trained based on FSVR. And then, the vibration predicting results are obtained based on the sequence of predicting factors and the trained model. This approach is applied to predict the swing of Kaplan turbine guide bearing, and its accuracy is verified by comparison experiments.

articleTitle: Hippocampal Neurons Model Implementation on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Hippocampus plays an important role in human cognitive function. In this paper, a modular idea is proposed. The modular implementation of hippocampal neurons model is described in detail, and the key problems of realizing hippocampal cortical neurons with FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) are explained. The proposed modeling algorithm based on the neuron model of FPGA is suitable for many channel models.

articleTitle: Analysis of Aerodynamic Characteristics of Iced Six-bundle Conductors Under Different Working Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: For the analysis of the wire galloping problem, the main load in the dynamic equation is derived from the continuous wind load in the natural world, and the wind load received by the wire can be characterized by the normalized aerodynamic coefficient. Therefore, determining the aerodynamic characteristics of each sub-conductor in the bundle conductor is a necessary condition for studying the bundle-conductor galloping. The aerodynamic characteristics of ice coating wires will show different changes with the thickness of ice coating, wind angle of attack and wind speed. At the same time, under the same working condition, the sub-conductors of the bundle conductors have different aerodynamic parameters due to the wake. Based on different working conditions, this paper analyzes and calculates the influence law of aerodynamic coefficients of six bundle conductors with different ice thickness, different wind angles of attack and different wind speeds, and provides basic load parameter support for wire galloping analysis.

articleTitle: Harmonic Threshold Estimation for Identification of Abnormal Data
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: The threshold of harmonic current is of great significance to determine whether the harmonic exceeds the standard. First, the principles of harmonic threshold calculation based on cloud-model method under various operating modes are presented. Then, a confidence-interval -based method is investigated to deduce the number of samples required for harmonic detection. Moreover, the method of adaptive threshold image merging is used to combine a variety of operation models under a similar threshold. The experimental results show that the threshold calculation method proposed in this study has the characteristics of high accuracy of identification, high fitness of sample size estimation, less computation and high confidence of threshold combination.

articleTitle: Multi-source Coordination and Scheduling Strategy of New Energy with High Proportion of Wind Power, Photovoltaic and Photothermal
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In recent years, scholars at home and abroad have mostly considered the coordination and scheduling optimization of wind power, photovoltaic and conventional thermal power units, but rarely considered the photothermal units in the research on the coordination and scheduling strategy of a high proportion of new energy grid connection. With the large-scale rise of photovoltaic power stations, how to coordinate and optimize the scheduling of wind-photovoltaic, solar-thermal and thermal power has become a key problem for the grid integration of high proportion of new energy at present. This paper mainly considers the economy of the grid-connected system, takes the maximization of grid-connected benefit as the goal, and based on the optimized constraint conditions, constructs a mixed integer programming model suitable for the scheduling strategy of this paper to coordinate and control the output power of thermal power, wind power, photovoltaic and photothermal power. In addition, the simplex method and interior point method are combined in MATLAB for programming solution and simulation analysis. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy can maximize the grid-connection benefit.

articleTitle: Calculation of Transient Magnetic Field of DC Field during Bipolar Short Circuit of Flexible DC Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Hybrid DC circuit breaker used in higher voltage flexible HVDC project is the current development trend. With the increase of the breaking current level of the DC circuit breaker, the magnetic field interference intensity of the surrounding secondary equipment is gradually enhanced. In this paper, the DC field of DingHai converter station of Zhoushan flexible DC transmission project is taken as the simulation object. Considering the commutation process of DC breaker breaking large current, the transient magnetic field interference value of the secondary equipment in the DC field is calculated when the bipolar short circuit occurs on the DC side. The results show that when the DC circuit breaker breaks the 15 kA current, the maximum value of the magnetic field interference of the secondary equipment near the positive and negative DC circuit breakers in the DC field are 700 A/m and 382 A/m, respectively. The peak value of the magnetic field interference can be included in the test level proposed in the electromagnetic compatibility standard "Test and Measurement Technology: Pulse Magnetic Field Immunity Test", but the duration time of the pulsed magnetic field waveform to be evaluated is recommended to be maintained at 3 ms.

articleTitle: A Method to Optimize Peak Load Regulation in Power Grid Considering HVDC
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Peak load regulation problems may be aroused when the HVDC link is connected to the power system. In this paper, the evaluation method of multi-objective segmentation is proposed based on the HVDC operation modes. And the comprehensive evaluation model is established by considering membership functions of peak load regulated surplus quantity in the peak load condition and the abandoned electric quantity in the low load condition. The model utilizes the comprehensive membership functions to evaluate the effect of HVDC link on the power grid and optimize the peak load regulation. The proposed approach is applied to the Yunnan power grid in 2017, with the access to the HVDC link from Yongren to Funing to analyze the peak load regulation.

articleTitle: Design of Degradation-Conscious Optimal Dispatch Strategy for Home Energy Management System With Rooftop PV and Lithium-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal control strategy for home energy management system equipped with rooftop solar photovoltaic panels working in conjunction with lithium-ion (Liion) based battery energy storage to achieve dispatchable generation/load under future dynamic distribution energy market environment. The control purpose is to reduce the overall operating costs with the consideration of battery degradation. A nonlinear model predictive control scheme is designed to determine the optimal dispatch power flow to the grid. A physics-based equivalent circuit model of Li-ion battery derived from electrochemical principles is used in the prediction model, due to its capability of predicting battery’s degradation behavior under arbitrary terminal power flow. The optimization problem is then formulated and dealt with deterministic dynamic programing, as the Li-ion battery is represented by highly nonlinear electrochemical model.

articleTitle: Research on Low Voltage Ride Through Strategy and Fault Calculation Equivalent Model of Power Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Power Electronic Transformer(PET) can realize flexible control of AC/DC hybrid distribution network and efficient absorption of new energy. During a grid fault, if PET can adopt a superior low-voltage ride-through(LVRT) strategy, the operational safety of PET itself and the stability of AC/DC hybrid grid can be improved significantly. Moreover, PET exhibits obvious controlled characteristics during LVRT operation, which brings difficulties for grid fault analysis and relay protection setting calculation. Therefore, it is urgent to study the LVRT strategy and fault equivalent model of PET, so as to provide guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the system and lay a theoretical foundation for grid fault analysis. In this paper, a LVRT strategy adapted to bidirectional power exchange of PET is proposed for the purposes of maintaining the system stability, assisting the system voltage recovery and protecting PET safety, based on which the fault current analytical expression of PET is obtained by deducing and analyzing the control model in the bidirectional rotating coordinate system. And the corresponding short-circuit current equivalent calculation model of PET is established. Finally, the correctness of the proposed LVRT strategy and the short-circuit calculation equivalent model is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Charging and Discharging Control Strategy of Dump Truck Braking Energy Recovery System Based on Self-adaption Two-Degree-of-Freedom PID
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: When working in harsh conditions, the dump truck brakes frequently. And the braking energy consumption of it accounts for a large proportion of the total energy consumption. Due to the wide range fluctuation and high frequency of the instantaneous wide range fluctuation on DC bus voltage, the efficient and stable control on braking energy recovery and utilization system is a key challenge that needs to be solved urgently. This paper proposes a self-adaption two-degree-of-freedom PID control strategy, which implements high efficient and stable control of the charging and discharging process of the system. Meanwhile, the response speed of charging and discharging current are accelerated and the interference resistant capacity is also improved in the charging and discharging process. The experimental platform of braking energy recovery and utilization system of the dump truck with 300kW/1800V supercapacitor and battery mixed energy storage was built. And the establishment of prototype had been completed. Finally, vehicle operation Experiment was conducted on the 730E tramcar in Ping Shuo An-Jialing coal mine. The experimental results were tested by a third party, and the efficiency of the braking energy recovery and utilization system reached 53.5%. The experimental result verified the efficiency, feasibility and stability of the charging and discharging control strategy.

articleTitle: Locating Forced Oscillation Source Using Granger Causality Analysis and Delay Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: Forced power oscillation inflicts great harm on power systems. A fundamental solution is to locate the oscillation source and remove it. This paper proposes a data-driven method to locate oscillation source using the spectral Granger causality analysis and arrival delay estimation of forced oscillation. The application of the spectral Granger causality analysis to locate oscillation source is proposed. The construction of the AR models and the feature selection for causality analysis are given. To provide comparison and confirmation, a method of arrival delay estimation of forced oscillation is proposed to determine the arrival sequence of forced oscillation at different generators. Cross correlation function is adopted to estimate time delays of oscillation arrivals and to distinguish cause generator from effect generators. The proposed data-driven method combines the spectral Granger causality and arrival delay estimation and is validated by several numerical cases. It is shown that the proposed method is model-free and needs only few recorded data.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of a Bi-directional Data Acquisition and Control System for Small-scale Solar Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2019 4th International Conference on Intelligent Green Building and Smart Grid (IGBSG)
abstract: In a wide area power dispatch system, accurate and timely online communication between central supervisory control center and distributed energy resource (DER) power plants plays an important role for power operation stability. In order to collect online photovoltaics (PV) data from massive small-scale devices with different proprietary protocols, we first develop a 61850-based data aggregation server supporting commonly used protocols in data exchange. Furthermore, bi-directional Modbus controllers are then designed to transform dispatch commands from control center to RS-485 PV inverter commands. Combined with the 61850-based aggregation server and bidirectional Modbus controllers, our proposed PV information and communication technology (PV ICT) architecture is capable of dispatching PV power generation on massive non-61850-standard PV inverters.
